title: Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer | Work From Home | $2.50 - $4 USD Per Hour
description:
# Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer | Work From Home | $2.50 - $4 USD Per Hour



We are looking for a **Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer** to join our growing team in a **100% work-from-home position**.



In this role, you will create print advertisements for newspapers and other publications using a specialized proprietary design platform. The platform is designed to make the ad creation process simple and efficient, and we will provide complete training on the software, workflow, and quality standards.



You do not need years of professional design experience, but you **must have some previous design experience and a good eye for design**. You should understand what makes an advertisement look clean, professional, balanced, and visually appealing.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Creating newspaper and print advertisements using our client's proprietary design platform

* Designing ads based on provided content, instructions, templates, and branding

* Arranging text, images, colors, fonts, and other design elements

* Making sure advertisements are visually clean, balanced, and professional

* Reviewing completed ads for spelling, formatting, alignment, spacing, and design issues

* Producing multiple advertisements throughout the workday while maintaining consistent quality

* Making revisions when necessary based on feedback

* Communicating and working closely with our trainers and other members of the design team



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has previous graphic design or other relevant design experience

* Has a strong eye for layout and visual presentation

* Understands basic design principles such as typography, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, color, and composition

* Has experience with Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar design software

* Has strong attention to detail

* Has good written and verbal English communication skills

* Is comfortable learning new software and systems

* Can follow instructions and established processes

* Is reliable, organized, and able to work effectively as part of a remote team

* Has a reliable computer and internet connection



You do **not** need to be an advanced graphic designer. We are looking for someone with a good design foundation and visual judgment who can learn our system and consistently produce quality work.



## Full Training Provided



We provide complete training for this position.



We have our own training system and dedicated trainers who will teach you how to use the design platform, understand the workflow, and create advertisements that meet our quality standards.



Previous experience with this specific platform is **not required**.



## Compensation & Work Setup



**Salary: $2.50 - $4 USD Per Hour**



This is a **fully remote, 100% work-from-home position**.



There will be opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibilities for team members who perform well and grow with the company.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your resume

* A short introduction about yourself

* A brief description of your previous print design or relevant design experience

* A portfolio or examples of previous design work, if available



A formal portfolio is not required, but we would like to see examples of your previous design work if you have them.



We're looking for reliable people with a strong eye for design who are eager to learn, communicate well, and work as part of a growing team.

title: ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst — NetSuite, Shopify & Integrations
description:
ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst — NetSuite, Shopify & Integrations

FLUENT ENGLISH AND US WORKING HOURS REQUIRED



When applying - please answer the following questions: 

What NetSuite administration have you handled and for how long?

Describe one difficult NetSuite or ERP problem that you personally investigated and solved. What was wrong and how did you find it?

What experience do you have coding, troubleshooting and maintaining SuiteScript, JavaScript, REST APIs or integrations?

Have you worked with Shopify, Celigo or another integration platform? Please describe.





------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 



We are a growing U.S.-based equipment and services company looking for a long-term ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst to support our business systems and users.



Our primary systems include Oracle NetSuite, ManagerPlus (M+), Shopify and system integrations/APIs.



This is a hybrid systems administration + business systems + technical support role. It is NOT a virtual assistant position and is NOT purely a programming role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys figuring out how systems work, troubleshooting problems, supporting users, improving processes and doing light development/automation when needed.



What You Will Do



NetSuite Administration



Provide day-to-day NetSuite user and administrative support

Manage forms, fields, custom records, roles and permissions

Create and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards and KPIs

Support workflows / SuiteFlow

Assist with imports, data cleanup and master-data maintenance

Troubleshoot transaction, configuration and user issues



Integration & Systems Support



Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite, Shopify, ManagerPlus and other applications

Investigate failed or incorrect data synchronization

Review logs and error messages and identify root causes

Troubleshoot APIs, data mappings and integration processes

Test system changes and integrations before deployment

Coordinate with developers when more complex programming is required



Technical / Development



Create or modify basic SuiteScript / JavaScript where appropriate

Work with REST APIs, JSON and web services

Build simple automations and workflows

Understand existing scripts sufficiently to troubleshoot problems and make minor changes

Assist with testing and documenting more complex development performed by other developers



User Support & Adoption



Work directly with Finance, Operations, Purchasing, Service and Ecommerce users

Help users understand and correctly use the systems

Troubleshoot user-reported problems

Create clear process and system documentation

Help develop training materials

Identify repetitive manual processes that can be automated

Help us improve system adoption and standardization

Required Skills

Hands-on NetSuite administration experience

Saved Searches and reporting

Custom forms, fields, records, roles and permissions

SuiteFlow / workflows

Strong ERP troubleshooting skills

Understanding of common ERP processes such as purchasing, sales orders, inventory and accounting

Experience working with system integrations

Basic understanding of APIs, REST, JSON and data mapping

Ability to read and understand JavaScript or similar programming

Strong problem-solving skills

Strong written and spoken English

Preferred Skills

SuiteScript 2.x / JavaScript

Shopify

Celigo or another integration/iPaaS platform

SuiteAnalytics / SQL

API integration experience

Experience with CMMS, work-order, field-service or equipment-management systems



ManagerPlus experience is NOT required. We will train the right person on this system.



Who Will Be Successful



We want someone who takes ownership of problems.



If a user says:



“This order did not transfer correctly from one system to another.”



We want you to be able to investigate the transaction, check the configuration and integration, review the logs, determine where it failed, fix what you can, and clearly explain what needs to happen next.



You should be comfortable moving between business users, ERP administration, data, integrations and code.



Position



Regular overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours will be required

How to Apply





Please answer the following:



How many years have you worked directly with NetSuite?

What NetSuite administration tasks do you personally handle?

Describe one difficult NetSuite or ERP problem that you personally investigated and solved. What was wrong and how did you find it?

What experience do you have with SuiteScript, JavaScript, REST APIs or integrations?

Have you worked with Shopify, Celigo or another integration platform? Please describe.







Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically interested in understanding what you personally have configured, troubleshot, automated or developed.

title: Part-Time Customer Service & Order Assistant — $5/hr — 24 Hours/Week
description:
PART-TIME POSITION | $5.00 USD per hour | Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time | 24 guaranteed paid hours per week



ABOUT THE POSITION

Friendly Party Rental LLC is a U.S.-based event-rental company serving customers in New York. We are looking for one dependable remote team member in the Philippines to help with customer service, phone calls, text messages,
, quotes, orders, scheduling, and basic office administration.



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.



We are currently entering our slower winter season, so this position begins at 24 guaranteed paid hours per week.



SCHEDULE

- Monday through Thursday

- 9:00 AM–3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

- 6 paid hours per day

- 24 paid hours per week



Applicants must understand that this is an overnight schedule in the Philippines.



Depending on U.S. daylight-saving time, the shift is approximately:

- 9:00 PM–3:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. daylight time

- 10:00 PM–4:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. standard time



Please only apply if you can maintain this schedule consistently long term.



PAY

- $5.00 USD per hour.

- Training and trial work are paid.

- This position starts at 24 guaranteed hours per week during our slow season.

- Additional hours may become available during our busier spring and summer event season depending on business volume and your performance.

- Additional hours are not guaranteed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will help Friendly Party Rental communicate with U.S. customers and keep the office organized.



Responsibilities include:

- Answering inbound customer phone calls professionally

- Making occasional outbound customer calls

- Responding to customer text messages

- Responding to customer
s

- Gathering event information from customers

- Answering common rental questions using our training and company policies

- Preparing or assisting with customer quotes

- Updating customer information

- Updating orders and order notes

- Reviewing rental dates and basic availability

- Helping customers understand normal delivery and pickup procedures

- Following up with open quotes and interested customers

- Following up with customers who have not completed their booking

- Keeping records accurate

- Performing simple administrative work when phone volume is light



Our winter call volume can sometimes be slow. This is normal.



When phones are quiet, you will not simply sit and wait for calls. You may work on customer follow-up, open quotes, text messages,
, order notes, lead follow-up, data cleanup, and other administrative work.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The right person should have:

- Excellent spoken English

- Excellent listening comprehension

- Professional written English

- Confidence speaking with U.S. customers by phone

- Customer-service experience

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow written procedures

- Good judgment

- Ability to learn new systems quickly

- Reliable attendance

- Ability to stay organized

- A quiet professional home workspace

- Reliable computer

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Good headset/microphone

- A realistic backup plan for internet or power problems



Previous party-rental experience is not required. We will train you on our products, policies, pricing, orders, and systems.



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:

- U.S. customer support

- Call centers

- Dispatch

- Booking or reservations

- Scheduling

- CRM systems

- Order entry

- Home services

- Event companies

- Rental companies



VERY IMPORTANT

We want somebody who will ask when they are unsure instead of inventing an answer.



Giving a customer incorrect information confidently is worse than asking for help.



Reliability is also extremely important. You must consistently be online and ready to work at the beginning of your scheduled shift.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, applicants must complete ALL of the following.



Start your application with the exact words:

FRIENDLY CUSTOMER



Then answer these questions:



1. Voice recording

Send a 60–90 second voice recording (include a link to it, for example Vocaroo or Google Drive). In the recording:

- Introduce yourself

- Describe your previous phone/customer-service experience

- Explain any experience speaking with U.S. customers

- Confirm that you understand the position requires working overnight Philippine hours

The recording should be natural. We are not looking for a fake American accent. We want clear English, strong listening ability, confidence, and professional customer communication.



2. Schedule confirmation

Write this exact sentence if it is true:

"I can consistently work Monday through Thursday, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM Eastern Time."



3. Current employment

Tell us:

- Whether you currently have another job or client

- What hours you currently work

- Whether those hours conflict with this position



4. U.S. phone experience

Tell us about any previous job where you answered phone calls from American customers. Include:

- Company/industry

- Your responsibilities

- Approximately how long you worked there



5. Difficult customer

In 3–6 sentences, describe one difficult customer situation you handled and what you did.



6. Work setup

Tell us:

- Your primary internet provider

- Approximate internet speed

- Backup internet option

- Computer type

- Headset/microphone

- Backup plan for a power outage



7. Written customer-service test

Customer message:

"Hi, my event is Saturday and your website won't let me check out because it's too close to the event date. Can you help?"

Do not invent a company policy. Write the response you would send if you did not yet know our exact policy.



Applications that do not include the requested voice recording and schedule confirmation will not move forward.

Organize receipts, invoices, and administrative records.

Excellent written English. You will write directly to our customers, often without review.

title: WhatsApp Sales Specialist — Travel Photography
description:
WhatsApp Sales Specialist — Travel Photography



Customer support + upselling · Remote · Full-time



About us



Picster arranges professional photoshoots for travellers. Someone visiting Paris, Venice, Santorini or Gran Canaria books a local photographer for an hour and gets their edited photos back within 24 hours. We work in over 75 destinations with more than 250 photographers.



Our customers message us constantly — on WhatsApp, through 
. They ask about locations, timings, what to wear, whether their dress is suitable, whether we can do sunrise. Every one of those messages is a sales conversation wearing a customer service hat.



That's the job.



The role in one sentence



You answer every customer message quickly and warmly — and you turn as many of them as possible into a bigger booking.



What a shift actually looks like



You open 
 to a queue of messages. Someone asks whether we shoot at the Eiffel Tower at sunrise. You answer properly — and then you mention that the 60-minute Premium gives them the tower and Trocadéro while the light's still good, for €40 more.



Someone's booked a Standard for their honeymoon. You notice the occasion and suggest the Proposal package. Someone's shoot finished yesterday — you check whether they've seen their gallery, and whether they'd like the full set.



Around a hundred and twenty messages come in each day. You're the only person answering them.



It's fast. You need to be quick, accurate, and genuinely nice to people — while always looking for the sale.



What you'll be measured on



We'll be straight with you about this, because we'd rather you knew from day one:



Revenue from upsells and add-ons. The number that matters most.

Number of upsells converted — offered versus accepted.

Response time — how fast a customer gets a real reply.

Inbox cleared — the day's messages answered within the day.

Customer sentiment — we read the conversations. Pushy doesn't work here.



You'll see all five numbers. So will we. No surprises in either direction.



What we're looking for



A salesperson first. We can teach you our products. We can't teach you to spot an opening. If you've done outbound, inside sales, or high-volume chat sales, tell us.



Excellent written English. You're writing to couples from the UK, Germany, the US and Scandinavia, often about their honeymoon or their engagement. It needs to read naturally and warmly. This is not a copy-paste job.



Fast, accurate typing and comfort handling many conversations at once.



Emotional intelligence. A lot of these messages are about proposals, honeymoons, pregnancies and anniversaries. Read the moment. A hard sell into an emotional message loses the booking and earns a bad review.



Self-direction. You'll be working alone, on European hours, without someone watching over you.



And one thing that will move you to the top of the pile



You know how to work with AI properly — and how to teach it.



We use AI to draft replies and handle repeat questions. We don't want someone who ignores it, and we don't want someone who blindly forwards whatever it produces.



We want someone who:



Spots the questions that come up twenty times a week and turns them into automated answers

Reviews AI drafts, fixes them, and feeds the corrections back so the next one is better

Writes clear prompts and knowledge-base entries

Knows when a message needs a human and when it doesn't



If you can get the AI handling the routine half of the inbox, you spend your whole shift on the half that makes money. That's the point. Tell us how you'd approach it.



Money



Base: 50,000PHP p/m



Commission: 5% of every upsell, add-on and extra you sell. No cap.



To give you a realistic idea: moving one customer from our €59 package to our €99 one, five times a day, is €200 a month on top of your base. Our highest-value add-on is worth €49 and around a third of customers currently take it — we think that number should be much higher, and that's your opportunity.



If you're good at this, you'll earn well above the base. That's the design.



Hours



Thurs - Mon, covering European customer hours (9am - 6pm) CET. 5 days a week, 2 rest days.



These hours are fixed and we track them. We'll be clear about that upfront — the role only works if someone is genuinely there when customers are messaging.



How to apply



Send us:



1 · A short note on your sales experience — what you sold, to whom, and how you were measured.



2 · This. A customer sends us:



"Hi! We're in Venice next Tuesday for our 10th anniversary. Do you do photos near the Grand Canal? How much?"



Write your reply exactly as you'd send it. Our Venice packages are €59 for 30 minutes and 20 photos, or €99 for 60 minutes and 50 photos.



3 · Two or three sentences on how you've used AI in a customer service or sales role, and how you'd use it here.



We read every application, and to be very honest, we love AI, but not for the full application. Please add your own style, NOT just copy paste to ChatGPT and send us the output.

We are looking for a long-term team member who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation, a good and stable work environment, and plenty of growth opportunities.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

- In partnership with our Senior Social Media Manager and Marketing Team, create and maintain a social media content calendar that supports primary brand stories and goals while also tapping into seasonal moments and appropriate trends

Posting:

, Instagram feed, Instagram Stories, and Pinterest, either within the app or by using tools such as Sprout Social or Later

Affiliate Marketing & Community Management

40 hours per week

BRAND DIRECT

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
This role is posted by TRES on behalf of Restive Collective, one of the agencies we support. You’ll be hired by and work directly with the Restive Collective team.



About Restive Collective

Restive Collective is a Singapore-based agency that uses personal branding for lead generation. We work with founder-led, service-based businesses — coaches, consultants, gym owners and other experts — and turn their real stories into short-form video and carousel content that brings in qualified leads, not just views.



Our funnels are deliberately simple and proven: short-form video content → Meta ads → lead form or WhatsApp automation / landing page → booked conversation. Every client is spending real money every month, and your job is to make that money work.



Why This Role Is Different

This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

Real lead-generation campaigns for real founders

Ad accounts with live monthly spend, reported and optimised daily

A tight, repeatable funnel where your decisions directly change lead volume and cost per lead

You’ll follow clear SOPs — and you’ll also be trusted to make judgment calls when the numbers call for it.

If you want to become a senior buyer who owns performance end-to-end, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

Run and optimise conversion-focused Meta campaigns 
 & Instagram) across our client portfolio

Follow the daily media-buying routine: morning — check numbers, queue new ads, log and report; afternoon — optimise, analyse what’s working, recommend next moves

Own campaign health — monitor performance, flag issues early and escalate opportunities to the founder

Set up new client ad accounts (one-time setup per client) and launch new creative batches as they come from our script and video team

Support simple funnel setup where needed — landing page, VSL page and WhatsApp automation (we have a ready framework; no complex builds)

Participate in occasional weekend number-reporting for urgent, higher-spend campaigns (numbers only, with advance heads-up — not full optimisation)

You’ll receive priorities and inputs directly from the founder and account manager — no stakeholder chaos. Our VA handles the admin so you can stay on performance.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

Writing scripts or designing creatives (we have a scriptwriter, video editor and carousel designer)

Client communication or account management

Redesigning offers or pricing

Juggling 50–100 accounts — we are a high-value, low-volume agency and will add buyers before overloading you

Your focus is campaign performance and health, with clear boundaries and structure.

Who This Role Is For

This role is a good fit if you:

Have hands-on experience running conversion ads (leads or sales) on Meta — not branding or awareness

Think in cost per lead, CPC, CTR and ROAS, and can explain why you scale, pause or kill an ad

Stay calm, analytical and accountable when things move fast

Respect structure but don’t freeze when conditions change

Communicate clearly, report proactively and take ownership seriously

Are ready to commit full-time to one team and grow with it



Who This Role Is NOT For

“Set-and-forget” ad managers who report once a week

Freelancers juggling multiple clients or running their own agency on the side

People who only want to run brand awareness or big-budget branding campaigns

Anyone uncomfortable with responsibility tied to real client spend



How We Work

At Restive Collective, you are judged on results delivered, not hours clocked.

Results-driven \u2014 what matters is your campaigns\u2019 numbers \u2014 cost per lead, lead volume and campaign health \u2014 and how proactively you report and act on them

Systems-led \u2014 clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA so you can focus on your actual craft

Small, focused team \u2014 you work directly with the founder, not through layers of management



Compensation & Growth

SGD 800 – 1,200 / month, depending on experience

Clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA supporting you so you can focus on performance

A growth path to Senior Media Buyer — as we add clients you’ll mentor the next buyer, help build our media-buying SOPs and shape how the agency scales

Exposure to funnels, WhatsApp automation and landing pages — grow beyond ads into full-funnel thinking

If you’re looking for a comfortable, low-pressure role, this isn’t it.

If you’re looking to own performance and grow with a young agency, you’ll thrive here.



How to Apply

Please complete the application form carefully. The questions are designed to understand how you think, not just what tools you’ve used.



👉 Apply here: 
 



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.







Final Note

We’re not looking for button-pushers.

We’re looking for a media buyer who:

Respects structure

Protects campaign performance

Takes ownership seriously

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you

title: Home Care Scheduler
description:
# Weekend Scheduling Manager



**Company:** Mālama Maika‘i Health and Wellness Alliance

**Location:** Remote

**Proposed pay:** $150 USD per week

**Coverage:** Saturday 5:00 a.m. through Monday 6:00 a.m. HST, including overnight on-call coverage

**Required team meeting:** Every Monday at 8:00 a.m. HST



## About the role



We are looking for a dependable Weekend Scheduling Manager to lead scheduling coverage for our home care clients and caregivers. You will take ownership of weekend callouts, open shifts, schedule changes, and urgent communication. Clients should know what is happening, who is helping them, and when they will receive their next update.



This role requires someone who can stay reachable throughout the assigned coverage window, act quickly when care is at risk, and hand off a clear account of unresolved issues to the weekday team.



## Responsibilities



* Monitor scheduling messages and calls throughout the assigned weekend coverage window.

* Respond promptly to caregiver callouts, late arrivals, cancellations, and client requests.

* Actively seek replacement caregivers when a shift is at risk. Keep working the coverage plan until it is resolved or escalated.

* Tell affected clients about schedule changes promptly. Give a specific time for the next update when coverage is still being arranged.

* Confirm changes with both the client and caregiver, then update the scheduling system.

* Record what happened, why a shift changed or was canceled, who was contacted, and the outcome.

* Escalate urgent care gaps, safety concerns, and complaints according to company procedures.

* Prepare a Monday handoff covering open shifts, unresolved concerns, cancellations, and follow-up needed.

* Attend the weekly team call every Monday at 8:00 a.m. HST.



## Availability and communication



You must be available for the assigned coverage period from **Saturday at 5:00 a.m. to Monday at 6:00 a.m. HST**, including overnight on-call coverage. Keep your phone and work communications accessible, acknowledge urgent messages promptly, and arrange an approved handoff if an emergency prevents you from covering the role.



Missed team calls, prolonged periods without a response, or failure to communicate schedule changes will be documented and addressed through performance review. Continued failures may affect future assignments or continued engagement. Pay for work performed will be handled according to the applicable agreement and law.



## Qualifications



* Experience scheduling home care, healthcare, or other time-sensitive services preferred.

* Strong English communication and calm problem-solving skills.

* Ability to manage several urgent issues while keeping accurate notes.

* Reliable internet, phone access, and a computer.

* Willingness to work the stated HST schedule, including nights and weekends.



**To apply:** Tell us about your scheduling experience and how you would handle a caregiver calling out shortly before a weekend shift.

The editor should be able to adjust the movement, speed, and pauses needed to clearly navigate the new handout recording.



4. Sync Audio and Video: The editor should be able to use a voiceover app to update scripts needed in some part of the video and sync the audio with what is shown in the video.



5. Insert new video recording: The editor should be able to record new video of the new handout navigation and insert it to the main video.



6. Transitions: The editor should apply the transition in the final edit based on the transition pattern from the original video.

* Experience in
 Ads or Google Ads

• Probationary Period: 6 months

o Months 0–3: USD 280/month

o Months 4–6: USD 300/month, subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months

Upon regularization, employees receive a guaranteed 13th Month Pay and at least one annual performance bonus equivalent to one month’s base salary during peak sales seasons. o If performance does not meet expectations, adjustments may be made in accordance with company standards.

o Performance-based incentives may be provided based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.



• After Regularization:

o Annual contract renewal is standard

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

o If overall performance—including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations—is considered outstanding, salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. (This has occurred in multiple past cases.)

o Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.

- 13th Month Salary provided

title: Clinic / Practice Operations Manager (Virtual, Long-Term)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice looking for an experienced Clinic / Practice Operations Manager for a long-term remote role.



This is NOT a junior VA task role, and it is NOT a clinical position. We need someone who can own day-to-day clinic operations end-to-end, think in systems, and run the practice with minimal hand-holding.



If you need step-by-step instructions for every small task, this role is not a fit. We want a manager who already understands how a U.S. outpatient practice runs and can take ownership.



WHAT “OWNERSHIP” MEANS HERE



You will manage clinic operations as a whole — not just complete isolated tasks. You should be able to:



See the full picture across credentialing, billing, scheduling, paperwork, and hiring

Spot problems early and fix them without waiting to be told

Build simple trackers, workflows, and follow-up systems so nothing falls through the cracks

Prioritize what matters for the practice, not just check boxes

Communicate clearly with insurers, providers, patients, and vendors

Gradually take on more operational responsibility as the clinic grows

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Own provider credentialing / recredentialing workflows (including CAQH and payer enrollment follow-up)

Track outstanding credentialing items and push them to completion

Oversee billing support, payment reconciliation, and discrepancy follow-up

Manage insurance verification and related administrative chasing

Oversee patient scheduling, appointment readiness, and incomplete paperwork clearance

Lead or support hiring: job posts, applicant screening, interview coordination, and onboarding

Maintain operational trackers, spreadsheets, and SOPs

Coordinate communication with insurance companies, providers, patients, and other organizations

Continuously improve clinic admin workflows so the practice runs smoother over time

IDEAL CANDIDATE



Strong preference for people who have already worked with U.S. healthcare practices (mental health / behavioral health is a plus).



You should have real experience in several of these:



Provider credentialing, CAQH, payer enrollment

Medical billing, payment reconciliation, insurance verification

Healthcare practice administration / clinic operations

EHR / practice management systems (SimplePractice is a strong plus; Headway / Spruce experience is also valued)

You must be:



A strong operator with big-picture judgment, not only task execution

Extremely organized and detail-oriented

Proactive — you close loops and follow up until done

Comfortable managing multiple workstreams and deadlines independently

Able to learn new healthcare software quickly

Strong in written and spoken English

Interested in a long-term role with growing ownership

NOT A FIT IF



You only want narrowly assigned VA tasks

You need constant reminders or detailed scripts for every step

You have little or no U.S. healthcare admin experience

HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and answer ALL of the following:



How many years have you worked with U.S. healthcare companies or medical practices?

Have you managed overall clinic/practice operations before (not only isolated tasks)? Briefly describe what you owned end-to-end—credentialing, billing, scheduling, hiring, or the full front/back office—and what improved under your management.

Describe your credentialing experience. Have you personally worked with CAQH or insurance payer enrollment?

What medical billing, payment reconciliation, or insurance verification experience do you have?

What EHR or practice-management systems have you used? (SimplePractice / Headway / Spruce if any)

Have you helped with recruiting, hiring, or employee/contractor onboarding?

What was your most recent healthcare-related position, and what did you own there?

What is your expected hourly rate (USD)?

How many hours per week are you available?

title: DIRECT RESPONSE VIDEO EDITOR
description:
$1000–$1,300/month + Performance Bonuses | Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote



IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are ONLY looking for candidates who have previously worked at:



• Resilia

• Lymphoria

• Rosabella

• Serene Herbs

• Everly

• ClarityMD



If you have not worked at one of these companies, please do not apply.



💰 ROLE DETAILS



Position: Senior Direct Response Video Editor

Type: Full-Time, Long-Term

Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month + bonuses for winning ads

Location: Fully Remote



This is a long-term role for an editor who understands DTC health and wellness advertising, direct response, and AI-powered creative production.



Your ads will be tested with real ad spend and performance data.



🎬 WHAT YOU'LL DO



Create high-performing video ads across formats such as:



• AI UGC

• Voiceover + B-roll

• Greenscreen

• AI avatars

• Claymation

• Pixar / 3D-style creative

• Podcast-style ads

• Product and story-driven ads



The goal is simple: create ads that capture attention, retain viewers, and drive conversions.



🧠 WHAT WE EXPECT



You should understand:



• Strong hooks and pattern interrupts

• Retention-focused pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• B-roll selection and visual sequencing

• Captions, kinetic text, and motion graphics

• Sound design and audio cleanup

• Basic color correction

• AI-generated creative and asset integration

• Clean project organization and reliable deadlines



You should be able to explain why an ad will or will not perform.



🛠️ TOOLS



Experience with tools such as:



• CapCut

• ElevenLabs

• HeyGen

• Kling

• Veo 3

• Nano Banana

• Higgsfield



You should also be comfortable learning new AI tools quickly.



🔥 WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

1. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



You must have worked at Resilia, Lymphoria, Rosabella, Serene Herbs, Everly, or ClarityMD.



2. DIRECT-RESPONSE THINKING



You understand:



Hook → Retention → Desire → Proof → Offer → CTA



3. SPEED AND QUALITY



You can complete 32 briefs per month while maintaining strong creative quality.



4. OWNERSHIP



You work independently, meet deadlines, respond quickly, and take feedback well.



5. AI SKILLS



AI is a core part of our creative workflow. You should know how to use AI assets without making ads feel obviously AI-generated.



🚫 DO NOT APPLY IF...



• You have not worked at one of the six listed companies

• You only create visually attractive videos without understanding performance

• You need constant supervision

• You are unwilling to learn new tools

• You are not interested in long-term creative growth



📝 HOW TO APPLY



Your application must include:



Which listed company you worked for

Your exact role and dates of employment

A brief description of your experience

Your portfolio with DTC or performance ad examples

Your strongest editing and AI skills

ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS

1. PERFORMANCE



Choose one successful ad you created and explain why it worked.



2. ITERATION



Describe an ad that underperformed, what the data showed, and what you changed.



3. AI CREATIVE PROCESS



Explain your process for creating AI UGC, avatars, claymation, 3D, podcast, or other AI-driven ads.



4. HIGH-VOLUME WORK



Tell us how you manage quality and deadlines when producing a high volume of ads.



⚠️ APPLICATION CODE WORD



Include ScaleMode somewhere in your application.



Applications without this code word will not be reviewed.



🎯 FINAL STEP



Shortlisted applicants will complete a trial task.



We are looking for someone who can think like a performance creative editor, not just someone who can edit videos.



If you have worked at one of the listed companies and can deliver high-quality creative consistently, we’d love to hear from you.

title: YouTube & AI Content VA — Video Editing / Shorts / Social Media
description:
I manage several US-focused YouTube and social media channels and am looking for a reliable, resourceful VA who can help grow and monetize a channel, not simply complete assigned tasks.



You will initially work on one channel or a defined set of responsibilities. Strong performers may later take primary responsibility for additional channels with increased compensation and performance incentives.



Main Responsibilities

Depending on the channel, responsibilities may include:

* Researching and/or writing scripts

* Creating and editing AI-assisted short-form videos

* Creating or assisting with long-form YouTube content

* Repurposing content for YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest

* Uploading and scheduling content

* Optimizing titles, descriptions, keywords, and basic SEO/GEO

* Researching affiliate products when relevant

* Maintaining simple performance, analytics, and revenue tracking

* Supporting UGC, brand research, affiliate, and other monetization projects

* Identifying problems and proposing solutions without waiting for detailed instructions



I’m Looking for Someone Who:

* Has strong written and spoken English

* Has real experience with YouTube and/or short-form social media content

* Can use AI tools efficiently

* Is organized and reliable with deadlines

* Understands analytics and performance, not just content production

* Understands that the goal is channel growth and monetization



Experience with any of the following is a plus:

YouTube Studio, ChatGPT, CapCut, Canva, AI video tools, Amazon Associates, Carrd, Kit/ConvertKit, GA4, Pinterest, affiliate marketing, UGC, or content analytics.



Work Structure

* Remote

* Flexible / output-based schedule

* Initial responsibility will usually be one channel or a defined workload

* Opportunity for ongoing channel management

* Additional compensation and performance incentives available for strong performers who produce measurable results



I am looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, but performance, reliability, and results are important.



To Apply

Start the first line of your application with your WhatsApp contact number.

Then answer the following:

1. What YouTube channels, social media accounts, or content projects have you personally worked on?

2. What AI, video editing, and content tools do you use?

4. Rank your strongest skills from strongest to weakest:

 * Video editing

 * Research / scripting

 * Channel management

 * Analytics

 * Affiliate marketing / monetization

5. What is your requested monthly rate for approximately 20 hours/week?

6. Please send 2–3 examples of your own relevant work and explain what you personally did for each one.



Please do not send a generic or AI-generated application.

title: Amazon Brand Manager
description:
We are looking for a talented and versatile Amazon Brand Manager! If you think that you have what it takes to be successful in this role, we welcome you to apply!



Do you like going from one meeting to another with non-stop action and solving problems every day while managing 8 people? Where you are trying to please clients and juggling tons of competing priorities? If so, this is the job for you.



Brand Managers own the relationships at our agency. It’s your job to make customers like us while delivering our team’s accurate non-stop activities.



Responsibilities:

• Manage clients' accounts assigned. The Brand Manager will act as the direct point of contact for the client, responsible for coordinating MAG's services, implementing strategy, communicating with clients, direct reports, and leadership.

• 2+ Direct Reports. In addition to client services, this position is also a managerial position, and following the completion of training, brand managers will be expected to lead a small team of Amazon specialists, who will assist the manager with delivering MAG services to the client.

• Brand managers are the company's backbone, directly responsible for our client accounts.

• Proactively provide a strategy for the account, communicate with the client, and ensure MAG process and deliverables are met.

• Delegate tasks properly to your direct reports and the MAG teams, follow up on delegations, hold staff accountable, and report back to the client.



Qualifications:

• Amazon Expertise: 1+ year with Seller Central (flat files, FBA, PPC, SEO, reinstatements, brand registry, Helium10, keyword research).

• Agency & Management: Experience handling multiple demands, leading teams, hiring, and performance management.

• Project & Client Management: Skilled in multitasking, project management, client communication, and account ownership.

• Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with tools like Zoom, Slack, Asana, and adapting in fast-changing environments.

• Passion for eCommerce: Independent, people-focused, and driven to grow client sales on Amazon.



Expectations:

• Competitive salary!

• Fun Fully Remote Culture – Community Culture, Team Oriented Environment

• You can have your OWN Amazon selling business and utilize company resources to build your own account! We love and ? encourage entrepreneurs, in fact, the majority of employees have their own selling accounts!

• Unlimited Learning and Growth – If you meet and exceed our core values and grow sales, you will have unlimited opportunities to grow, advance, promote, and earn more.

description:

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Remote • Flexible • No Experience Required)
description:
We're hiring Short-Form Video Editors to help us produce a high volume of social media content for a fast-growing U.S. real estate company.



This is an execution-focused role. You'll follow our proven editing system to turn raw footage into engaging short-form videos for platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.



You won't be expected to film content, come up with ideas, or make creative decisions. We provide the workflow, examples, and editing style—you simply execute.



We're only hiring a small group of editors for this round. Once all positions are filled, applications will close.



Why You'll Like This Role:



* No experience required—we'll teach you our editing process

* Fully remote

* Work whenever you want

* No meetings or micromanagement

* Unlimited work available

* Clear editing system with step-by-step instructions

* Earn more by completing more videos



If you enjoy structured, repeatable work and want a flexible way to earn income from home, this is a great opportunity.



What You'll Do:



* Edit short-form videos in CapCut Pro

* Turn raw footage into polished social media videos

* Follow our editing style and workflow

* Add captions, pacing, cuts, and basic effects as instructed

* Submit completed videos on time



You will not be responsible for:



* Filming content

* Writing scripts

* Brainstorming ideas

* Managing social media accounts



Your job is to produce clean, consistent edits by following our system.



Pay:



**$1 USD per finished minute of edited video**



Examples:



* 1-minute video = $1



* 3-minute video = $3



* 5-minute video = $5



* Paid per completed video



* No earnings cap



* The more you edit, the more you earn



Schedule:



* 100% remote

* Work whenever you want

* No minimum hours

* No fixed schedule



This is a production-based role, not an hourly position.



Requirements:



* Computer capable of editing videos

* Reliable internet connection

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions

* Good English comprehension

* **Active CapCut Pro subscription (required)**



**Important:** You must already have your own CapCut Pro subscription. We do **not** provide, reimburse, or share CapCut Pro accounts.



Who This Is Perfect For:



* Beginners who want to learn video editing

* Editors looking for flexible work

* People who enjoy following systems

* Detail-oriented individuals

* Reliable people who consistently meet deadlines



This Role Is NOT For You If:



* You want full creative control

* You prefer hourly pay or a guaranteed salary

* You don't like following established workflows

* You don't have access to CapCut Pro



We're reviewing applications as they arrive and hiring quickly.



If accepted, you'll receive onboarding materials and can begin working almost immediately.



We expect these positions to fill quickly, so apply as soon as possible if you're interested.

title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Social Media and Digital Marketing Specialist

• Remote | Part-time 20 to 30 hours per week

• Potential to move into full time based on performance

• Must overlap with U.S. Mountain Time

• Rate: $8 to $12 per hour, depending on experience

• Bi weekly pay | Time tracking required



Read Before Applying

This role requires attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to understand and follow directions.

We do not review generic, copy-paste, or fully AI-generated applications. Let your creativity, originality, and actual skills show.



About the Role

We are a growing plant-based chef and education business looking for a Social Media and Digital Marketing Specialist to help manage our social presence, grow our community, and support digital marketing efforts.



We are looking for someone who is social media savvy, proactive, creative, and able to work independently.



Social media strategy, engagement, and community growth are the priority. Video editing is an important supporting skill.



What You Will Be Responsible For

• Social Media and Community Growth

• Manage Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Eventbrite, and Meetup

• Plan, create, and publish consistent content

• Manage daily engagement and community interaction

• Understand what to post, when to post, and how to keep the brand active

• Recognize real-time content opportunities

• Monitor performance and recommend improvements



Digital Marketing

• Support Meta Ads and paid campaigns

• Understand leads, conversions, and campaign performance

• Support promotions for classes, events, and services



Content Execution

• Edit short-form videos using CapCut

• Turn existing footage into engaging social content

• Create timely content for events, classes, announcements, and real-time moments

• Follow brand guidelines and maintain a consistent visual presence



Who This Role Is For

• 2 or more years of social media or digital marketing experience

• Strong social media and community engagement skills

• Experience with Meta Ads and paid campaigns

• Strong understanding of leads and conversions

• Experienced with CapCut and short-form video editing

• GoHighLevel experience required

• Creative with a strong eye for content and branding

• Self-starter who takes initiative

• Able to work independently with minimal supervision

• Reads to understand and follows direction

• Communicates clearly and early

• Team player who applies feedback

• Reliable internet and work setup

• Saturday availability is a plus, not required



What Success Looks Like

• Consistent, high-quality content every week

• Increased engagement and community growth

• Strong and cohesive brand presence

• Timely content opportunities are captured

• Campaigns are monitored and improved

• Clear recommendations based on performance



Trial Task

• Selected candidates may be asked to complete a short trial task.

• Do not simply have AI create the task for you. We use an AI checker, and submissions should demonstrate your own creativity, originality, judgment, and skills.

• We want to see how you think, not just how polished an AI-generated answer can look.



How to Apply

• Send the following:

1. Resume

2. Record and share an accessible Video Introduction using the guide below:

• Who you are

• Your experience

• One unique thing that makes you a strong fit for this role

Attention Check: Start your video by saying "Green Mango."

3. Portfolio

• Actual social media accounts you managed

• Content you created

• Short-form videos or reels you edited

4. 2 to 3 Client or Employer References

• Application Subject: Your email subject line must include "Green Mango."



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Final Note

• We are looking for someone who can think, execute, take initiative, and help us grow.

• If you need constant direction, this role will not be a fit.

title: Graphic designer
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Specialist

Base Image Creation | High-Level Creative Team | Growth Opportunity

We are looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist who can create high-quality base images made specifically for video advertisements.

This is not a video editing role.

Your responsibility is to create the foundation image — the main visual that everything starts from.

These base images will later be used by our animation team for B-roll creation and by our video editing team for final advertisements.

You are the first and most important step in the creative process.

there should be almost no visible difference between your work and reality.

We are looking for someone with very high standards, strong taste, attention to detail, and someone who understands what makes an ad look expensive, trustworthy, and built to convert.

You will be joining a fast-growing international e-commerce brand with a 15-person marketing team focused heavily on performance marketing and creative testing.

Create high-quality base images for advertisement use

Turn storyboard briefs into strong visual foundations for video ads

Build animation-ready assets that can later be turned into B-roll

Make sure all visuals are realistic, premium, and conversion-focused

Avoid unnatural visuals, obvious mistakes, and scam-looking creatives

Continuously improve outputs so ads feel real and trustworthy

Stay updated with the newest creative systems and workflows

Work closely with our creative, animation, and video teams

Understand that your work is the starting point of the entire ad production process

Around 50 hours per week

title: Fractional Head of Marketing — Own the Strategy, Not Just the To-Do List
description:
⚠️ Please read first: This is NOT a social media manager role. We are not accepting applicants whose experience is primarily in social media management (SMM). We're hiring a strategic marketing leader — please only apply if that's you.



Fractional CMO Wanted — Own the Strategy, Not Just the To-Do List



Most marketing hires wait to be told what to post.

We're looking for the opposite: an experienced Chief Marketing Officer who walks in asking:

"Is our marketing actually working?"

"Where are we getting real ROI?"

"What should we stop doing tomorrow?"

"Where should we invest more — and why?"



If those are the questions you ask before anyone asks you, keep reading.



Who we are

We're the American Academy of Estate Planning Attorneys (AAEPA), a U.S.-based organization that helps attorneys grow their law firms through membership, training, and strategic education. We're established, we're growing, and we're ready for a senior marketing mind to help us grow smarter.



The role

This is a Fractional CMO position — part-time, remote, high-trust. You won't be handed a checklist. You'll be handed the whole marketing ecosystem and asked to make sense of it.

We need someone who can look at everything we're doing, dig into the numbers, and tell us — with confidence — what's working, what isn't, why, and what we do next.



What you'll own

- Audit our current marketing and determine what's actually producing results.

- Build and monitor tracking so we can measure campaign performance and ROI with confidence.

- Recommend where to invest, cut, or reallocate the marketing budget.

- Analyze our CRM, contact database, lifecycle stages, funnels, and attribution.

- Spot growth opportunities we're missing.

- Deliver a focused 30/60/90-day plan built around high-impact activities.



What you bring

- Senior-level B2B marketing experience — ideally as a CMO, marketing director, or fractional marketing leader.

- Comfort living in the metrics: ROI, conversion rates, attribution, CAC, budgets.

- Real command of CRMs, funnels,
 marketing, automation, and analytics.

- The judgment to work independently, prioritize ruthlessly, and make smart calls with limited hours.

- Excellent written English and clear, confident communication.



Big bonus if you've worked with membership organizations, professional associations, coaching, training, education, or other longer-sales-cycle business models.



This is a great fit if you…



- Love figuring things out.

- Don't need to be managed hour by hour.

- Can comfortably say, "This isn't working, and here's why."

- Know how to turn data into decisions.

- Want real, visible impact on a growing organization.



This is NOT a fit if you're an executor looking for tasks to check off, or if your background is primarily social media management. We have people for execution. We need someone to own the strategy.



How to apply (please read — this matters):

Don't send a generic application. In your reply, tell us:



- One marketing program you audited or ran where you changed the decision based on the data — what did you find, and what did you recommend?

- The tools/CRMs and analytics stacks you know best.

- Your availability (hours/week) and your expected rate.



Applications that follow these three steps go to the top of our list. Applications that don't, we skip.



If this sounds like you — or someone you rate highly — apply or share it with them.

title: CRM & Follow-Up Specialist (Wealthbox) - Financial Advisory Firm
description:
Please start your application with the words "Wealthbox Ready" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US



Klyman Financial is a growing US-based financial advisory and life insurance practice. We help families and business owners with investment management, retirement planning, and life insurance. Our business grows through client referrals, professional partners, webinars, and social media, which means every lead and every follow-up matters.



We are moving our client and prospect management into Wealthbox, a CRM built specifically for financial advisors, and we are looking for one dedicated person to own it from day one.



THE ROLE



This is not a data entry job. We need someone who takes ownership of our CRM and our follow-up process, and who is comfortable holding a small, busy team accountable.



Right now, good prospects slip through the cracks after meetings, no-shows, and "let's reconnect next month" conversations. Your job is to make sure that stops happening.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Set up and run Wealthbox

- Design a full system for our CRM

- Configure Wealthbox and recreate the workflows we currently use in GoHighLevel (pipelines, stages, tasks, tags, lead sources)

- Keep records clean, complete, and up to date

- Work with our GoHighLevel contractor to connect our webinar and lead systems



Own the follow-up process

- Build a repeatable follow-up system so no prospect is forgotten after a meeting, no-show, or postponed decision

- Create a daily list of who needs to be contacted, when, and by whom

- Set up different follow-up timing and messaging based on each lead's situation, not one generic message for everyone

- Until Wealthbox is fully live, run an interim follow-up tracker in Trello or similar with dates and notes



Recover past opportunities

- Organize and help review roughly 2,000 past leads with our leadership team

- Sort them by fit and priority, and place the right people into follow-up or
 drip sequences

- Close out low-fit or inactive records so the pipeline stays focused



Keep the team accountable

- Check in with team members to confirm assigned follow-ups and tasks were actually completed

- Prepare for and help run a recurring CRM review meeting, reporting what is outstanding and what is done

- Track where leads come from (ads, webinar, newsletter, referrals) through to booked meetings and new clients



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:

- 2+ years of hands-on CRM experience (Wealthbox, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or similar)

- Experience building pipelines, task automations, and
 follow-up sequences, not just entering data

- Proactive and organized. You notice when something is falling behind and you follow up without being asked

- Comfortable politely following up with US-based team members, including senior staff

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail and a high standard for confidentiality

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Able to overlap at least 4 hours per day with US Eastern Time business hours



Nice to have:

- Wealthbox experience specifically

- Experience in financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry

- Familiarity with Zapier, Calendly, Zoom, or Trello

- Experience cleaning up and organizing a large, messy contact database



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



You will be the person who owns this system, not someone waiting for instructions. If you like bringing order to chaos, seeing clear results from your work, and being a trusted part of a small team that is growing fast, this is a great fit. There is real room to grow as the firm expands.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short description of a CRM you set up or cleaned up, and what changed because of your work

3. A 2 to 3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through a CRM workflow or follow-up system you have built (screen share is great)

4. Your answers to these two questions:

   - A prospect booked a meeting, did not show up, and has not replied to one follow-up
. What do you do next, and how do you make sure it happens?

   - A team member has not completed a follow-up task that is overdue by 3 days. How do you handle it?



Remember to start your application with "Wealthbox Ready."

title: Junior Web Developer
description:
We're ApartmentHub, a growing rental platform in the Netherlands. We help tenants find and apply for apartments through a bilingual application website, and we run an internal CRM that our team uses every day. We're looking for a motivated Junior Full-Stack Developer who is comfortable on both the front end and the back end and wants to grow fast by shipping real features to real users.



This is not a "just follow tickets" role. You'll own features from the database to the screen: designing the table, writing the API, building the page, and deploying it. If you enjoy seeing the whole picture and not just one piece of it, you'll fit right in.



Front-end responsibilities



Build responsive, user-friendly pages and components in Next.js (App Router) and React

Write clean TypeScript and CSS (CSS Modules, Tailwind, or similar)

Turn designs and tickets into polished, working interfaces

Handle forms, validation, loading states, and error handling

Support our bilingual (Dutch/English) website



Back-end responsibilities



Build and maintain API routes and server-side logic with Node.js and Next.js server functions

Design and manage database tables, queries, and relationships in Supabase (Postgres)

Work with Supabase authentication, storage, and row-level security

Write SQL for reporting, data fixes, and CRM features

Integrate third-party services and APIs



Across the stack



Use GitHub daily: branches, pull requests, code reviews

Deploy and monitor on Vercel, including environment variables and debugging failed builds

Use Claude Code and other agentic AI tools to move faster, while still understanding, reviewing, and testing the code they produce

Debug issues end to end, from the UI down to the database



What we're looking for



1–2 years of experience, or strong personal projects we can look at

Solid foundation in both front-end (React/Next.js, TypeScript, CSS) and back-end (Node.js, SQL) development

Has built at least one project that includes a database, an API, and a user interface

Familiar with Git and GitHub workflows

Has used AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and knows their limits

Good written English and clear communication

Self-motivated: you figure things out, ask good questions, and don't wait to be told every step

Reliable internet and a working setup



Nice to have



Supabase or PostgreSQL experience

Experience with multilingual (i18n) websites

Experience building dashboards, admin panels, or CRM-style tools

Projects deployed on Vercel you can show us



What we offer



Long-term, stable role with a real product and real users

Full-stack experience on a modern stack, not stuck in one corner of the codebase

Mentorship and fast learning

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, a skill that's only getting more valuable

Room to grow as you prove yourself



How to apply

To show us you read the full post, start your application with the words "I ship with AI". Applications without this will not be reviewed.



Please include:



Your GitHub profile or links to 1–2 projects you built (live links are a plus). At least one should include both a front end and a back end/database

A short answer: tell us about a bug you got stuck on, whether it was in the UI, the API, or the database, and how you tracked it down

Which AI coding tools you've used and one thing you learned the hard way using them

Optional but recommended: a 1–2 minute Loom or video introducing yourself

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist



Full-Time Remote | Flexible Schedule | Philippines



Growth Path: Digital Marketing Manager



We’re not looking for someone to simply complete a list of marketing tasks. We’re looking for someone who wants to OWN digital marketing and grow with us.



Lambert Home Inspections is a fast-growing home inspection company based in Northern Virginia. Along with our residential inspection company, our team operates National Commercial Inspections and Capital Environmental, giving our marketing team the opportunity to build and grow three different brands.



We’re looking for a creative, analytical, tech-savvy Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist in the Philippines who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



This is NOT a typical Virtual Assistant position.



You’ll work directly with our leadership and growth team and eventually take ownership of digital marketing across all three companies.



Our goal is simple:



Hire a great Digital Marketing Specialist → develop them → give them ownership → grow them into our Digital Marketing Manager.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



PAID DIGITAL MARKETING



You’ll help manage and eventually take ownership of:



Google PPC campaigns

Google Local Services Ads (LSA)

Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising

Retargeting campaigns

Keyword and search-term optimization

Negative keywords

Geographic targeting

Advertising budgets

A/B testing

Conversion tracking

Cost-per-lead and customer-acquisition tracking

We currently work with an outside digital marketing agency. During your first few months, you’ll learn how our existing campaigns are managed, review their reporting and help us build our own internal systems.



The goal is for you to eventually take ownership of our digital advertising in-house.



WEBSITE + GOHIGHLEVEL



You’ll help us move and manage our websites through GoHighLevel (GHL) and continually improve them.



This includes:



Website updates

Creating landing pages

Building city/location pages

Creating service pages

Forms and funnels

CRM integrations

Conversion tracking

Website optimization

Marketing automations



We don’t want websites that just look good.



We want websites that generate leads.



SEO + AEO



You’ll help us dominate search across the markets we serve.



Responsibilities may include:



Local SEO

Keyword research

City and service landing pages

On-page SEO

Internal linking

Technical SEO

Schema

Google Business Profile optimization

Backlink opportunities

Search ranking tracking

AI search / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

Optimizing content for Google and AI platforms



SOCIAL MEDIA + CONTENT



Our Growth team will capture real-world content from inspections, events, real estate agents, our team and the field.



Your job is to turn that raw content into something people actually want to watch.



You’ll help create:



Instagram/Facebook Reels

Short-form videos

Social media posts

Hooks and captions

Graphics

Educational content

Before/after content

Team/culture content

YouTube content

Content calendars



We want someone who understands that social media in 2026 shouldn’t feel like a corporate brochure.



We want content that’s modern, authentic, entertaining and educational.



✍️
 + CONTENT MARKETING



You’ll also help create:



Weekly/monthly blogs

Realtor newsletters

Client newsletters

 campaigns

Lead nurture campaigns

Past-client campaigns

Referral campaigns

Seasonal marketing campaigns

Automated follow-up sequences



You’ll be working across three different brands, which means there will always be something new to build, test or improve.



ANALYTICS + KPI TRACKING



This is a major part of the position.



We don’t want to guess whether our marketing works.



We want the numbers to tell us.



You’ll help maintain our marketing dashboards and track:



Leads by source

Bookings by source

Revenue by source

Cost per lead

Cost per booked customer

Customer acquisition cost

Return on ad spend

Advertising conversion rates

Website conversion rates

Organic traffic

SEO rankings

Google Business Profile performance

Social media performance

 performance

Lost leads

Marketing-generated revenue

Cross-company referrals



You’ll help prepare the numbers for a monthly marketing meeting with company leadership where we review what worked, what didn’t and what we’re doing next.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You don’t need to know absolutely everything on Day One.



But you should be someone who loves learning, figuring things out and getting better.



We’re looking for someone who is:



Creative

Analytical

Organized

Tech-savvy

Detail-oriented

Comfortable with numbers

Comfortable using AI

A strong communicator

Self-motivated

Curious

Reliable

Excited about digital marketing

Interested in building a career rather than jumping from client to client



Experience with some combination of the following is strongly preferred:



Google Ads • Meta Ads • SEO • GoHighLevel • GA4 • Google Search Console • Google Tag Manager • WordPress/Web Design • Canva • Video Editing • Social Media • Email Marketing • CRM Automations • AI Marketing Tools



YOU’LL PROBABLY LOVE THIS JOB IF…



You watch marketing videos because you actually enjoy them.



You see a bad website and immediately start thinking about how you’d improve it.



You want to know why one advertisement generated 50 leads while another generated five.



You like experimenting with AI and new marketing technology.



You’d rather be given a goal than have someone tell you exactly what button to click every five minutes.



And you want the opportunity to eventually say:



“I run digital marketing for three growing U.S. companies.”



WHERE THIS POSITION CAN GO



We’re hiring a Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, but we don’t want you to stay a Specialist forever.



As our companies grow and you demonstrate that you can manage our marketing successfully, our goal is to develop this position into:



DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER



You could eventually oversee digital marketing strategy across:



- Lambert Home Inspections

- National Commercial Inspections

- Capital Environmental



As the companies continue growing, this could eventually mean helping build and manage a larger internal marketing team.



We want someone who grows as we grow.



THE POSITION



Location: Philippines – Remote



Schedule: Full-Time – 40 Hours Per Week. Flexible Scheduling and Workweek



Compensation: $7–$10 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated skills



This is intended to be a long-term position dedicated to our companies, not a temporary freelance project.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



We’re less interested in how impressive your résumé sounds and more interested in what you can actually do.



STEP 1 — APPLICATION



Send us:



Your résumé

A short introduction

Your digital marketing experience

Examples of campaigns you’ve managed

Websites/landing pages you’ve created

SEO results

Social/video examples

GHL experience

Any marketing dashboards or reporting you’ve created

Don’t have examples of everything?



That’s okay.



Show us what you’re great at.



STEP 2 — SHORT VIDEO



Selected applicants will submit a short video introducing themselves and answering a few questions.



We want to meet the person behind the résumé.



Tell us what you’re good at, what you’re currently learning and where you want your career to be three years from now.



STEP 3 — INTERVIEW



Top applicants will meet with our team by video.



This isn’t meant to be an interrogation.



We want to learn how you think, how you communicate and whether you’ll fit with our team.



STEP 4 — PAID MARKETING CHALLENGE



Finalists may complete a short paid skills challenge involving real-world marketing situations similar to what you’ll encounter here.



Examples could include:



Reviewing a sample Google Ads campaign

Evaluating a website page for SEO

Creating a landing-page concept

Analyzing marketing KPIs

Turning raw video into a social Reel

Creating a marketing campaign idea

We’re looking at how you think, not just whether you know every answer.



STEP 5 — FINAL INTERVIEW + OFFER



We’ll discuss the challenge, answer your questions and determine whether we’re a good long-term fit for each other.



If we are…



Welcome to the team. ????



ONE LAST THING…



We move fast.



We try new things.



We use technology.



We aren’t afraid of AI.



We measure results.



We have fun.



And we’re building something much bigger than where we are today.



If you’re looking for a position where you can learn, experiment, take ownership and eventually lead digital marketing across multiple growing companies…



we want to hear from you.

title: Sourcing Agent (Asia Suppliers, Custom Products)
description:
NO VIDEO IS NO REPLY



About the Company



We are a fast-growing international B2B brand. We supply custom branded grip socks and studio essentials, such as bags, towels, and drinkware, to Pilates, yoga, and barre studios across six markets worldwide. Everything we sell is made to order, with custom designs and custom packaging. We are a start-up, not a "slow corporate" company. We move fast, we care about how things look, and we treat our clients like partners, not just accounts.



If a start-up pace and environment sound exciting to you, keep reading. If that's not your style, this isn't the right role, and it's better we both know that now.



About the Role



Our product range is growing fast. Next to socks, we keep adding new products like bags, towels, drinkware, and accessories, and every new product needs the right manufacturer. That's where you come in.



As our Sourcing Agent, you find, evaluate, and build relationships with manufacturers, mainly in Asia. You request quotes, compare suppliers, negotiate prices and minimum order quantities, and manage samples until a product is ready to sell. Once a supplier is on board, you pass orders on to them and keep the relationship and supplier information in good shape.



Our clients order for a studio launch, an opening, or an event. The delivery date is a promise they have already made to their own members, so we sell on speed and reliability. The suppliers you bring in need to match that standard.



We are a dynamic company and we like to implement improvements fast. We're not looking for someone who just follows the process, but for someone who makes it better. If you see a smarter way to do something, we want you to speak up, take the lead, and make it happen.



We're Hiring for the Long Term



We are not looking for a short-term hire. We're looking for someone who wants to build something with us for years to come. If you grow with us and show what you can do, you'll have a long-term place on our team.



About the Hours



This is a 40-hour position with flexible hours. You plan your own day, as long as you're available for part of the day to overlap with our Dutch team and with our suppliers in Asia. During onboarding we'll agree on fixed overlap moments so your questions get answered fast while you learn the business.



What You'll Be Doing



Sourcing New Products & Suppliers



* Find and research manufacturers for new and existing product categories (socks, bags, towels, drinkware, accessories, and more).

* Request and compare quotes on price, quality, MOQ, lead time, customization options, and packaging.

* Negotiate prices, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms.

* Vet suppliers on reliability, quality, communication, and capacity before we commit.

* Build a backup supplier for our key products, so we never depend on just one factory.



Samples & Product Development



* Coordinate samples with suppliers and make sure they match our specs and branding.

* Give clear feedback to suppliers until a product meets our standard.

* Work with our design team so custom designs, colors, and packaging can actually be produced.



Orders



* Pass new orders on to our suppliers, with all the correct details and files (design, quantities, sizes, colors, materials, packaging, deadlines).

* Double-check every order before it goes out, because one small mistake here means a wrong product for the client.

* Follow up with suppliers so orders leave the factory on time, and flag delays to the team early.



Supplier Management



* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with our suppliers.

* Keep supplier information, prices, MOQs, and lead times accurate and up to date.

* Review supplier performance and help solve quality issues or factory errors together with our complaints team.

* Keep an eye on better or cheaper options in the market, even for products we already sell.



Process Improvement



* Right now, we send orders and design files to suppliers through WhatsApp, WeChat, and different platforms. It works, but it's not organized. We want you to help us build a clear, reliable way of sending and tracking orders, and take the lead in making it happen.

* Look critically at how we source and order, and spot what can be faster, simpler, or more reliable.

* Set up and improve templates, checklists, and workflows for quotes, samples, and orders.

* Use AI tools and automation to save time on repetitive tasks.



Across All Tasks



* Communicate with suppliers via
, WeChat, WhatsApp, Slack, and phone.

* Use AI tools daily for translation, drafting, and research. We work with suppliers and clients worldwide, so this is a core part of the job.



Requirements



* Experience in sourcing, procurement, or purchasing, ideally with manufacturers in Asia.

* A proven track record of finding suppliers and negotiating prices and terms.

* High-level American English, both written and spoken. This is a must.

* Confident on the phone. You'll regularly call suppliers to negotiate and solve problems.

* Highly detail-oriented. You check everything twice, in specs, samples, and orders.

* Proactive. You follow up before things go wrong, not after.

* A natural improver. You see what can be done better and you take action.

* Looking for a long-term role and ready to commit to one company.

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel).

* Speaking Mandarin Chinese is a strong plus.
