title: Creative Talent & Operations Manager For Ecommerce Brand
description:
Salary: $1,300–$1,700 USD/month depending on experience



We are a fast-growing e-commerce company producing hundreds of video advertisements every month.



We're building a much larger network of video editors, and we're looking for one person to completely own the system of finding, onboarding, tracking, and managing editor talent.



This is **not a traditional HR role** and it is not just recruiting.



Your job is to make sure our creative strategists always have enough talented editors available to produce great work.



## What You Will Own



You will manage the editor pipeline from beginning to end:



**Find editors → Review portfolios → Approve trials → Onboard → Assign to creative teams → Track performance → Keep, Bench, or Remove**



Our goal is to build a large, high-performing network of editors without our founders or creative strategists having to manage the administrative side of the process.



### Recruiting



You will continuously find talented video editors through:



- OnlineJobs.ph

- Upwork

- LinkedIn

-
 groups

- Freelance communities

- Referrals

- Other sourcing channels you discover



You will review portfolios and identify editors who appear talented enough to enter our paid trial program.



We care much more about the quality of someone's work than how well they interview.



### Trial Management



New editors enter a paid trial period of up to 30 days.



You will:



- Explain the trial structure

- Confirm rates and availability

- Complete onboarding

- Add them to our systems

- Assign them to the appropriate creative strategist

- Make sure they receive work

- Track their output and performance

- Follow up when someone becomes inactive

- Collect feedback from creative strategists



The editors will work on real projects during their trial.



We do not need lengthy interview processes or artificial test projects. Their actual work is the test.



### Editor Operations



You will maintain visibility into:



- Who is currently on trial

- Who is a permanent/core editor

- Who is on our backup bench

- Who should be removed

- Which creative strategist each editor works with

- How much work editors are receiving

- Turnaround times

- Revision frequency

- Editor capacity

- Editor utilization

- Upcoming 30-day trial decisions



We currently operate primarily through **ClickUp**, so you should be very comfortable using project-management systems and maintaining accurate data.



### Keep / Bench / Cut



You will work with our Creative Strategists to determine what happens with each editor.



At the end of a trial, an editor will generally move into one of three groups:



**CORE** — Excellent editor we want working with us permanently.



**BENCH** — Good editor we want to keep available for additional capacity or future projects.



**CUT** — Not the quality, speed, reliability, or fit we need.



You will coordinate these transitions and make sure there are no editors sitting in the system without a clear status.



## What Success Looks Like



Your job is not simply to "hire editors."



Your job is to maintain enough **proven editing capacity** for our creative team.



If our creative strategists need more editors, you should already have candidates moving through the pipeline.



If someone isn't performing, you should notice it.



If an editor is barely receiving work, you should figure out why.



If our team needs five more strong AI video editors, you should know where they are going to come from.



We want someone who eventually runs this system without needing the founder to constantly check on it.



## You Might Be a Great Fit If...



You are extremely organized.



You like building systems and keeping things from falling through the cracks.



You are comfortable managing many freelancers or employees at once.



You are proactive and don't wait for someone to tell you every next step.



You are comfortable following up with people repeatedly.



You can make decisions using data and feedback.



You are comfortable removing people who are clearly not working out.



You understand that great talent should receive more opportunities.



You enjoy recruiting, operations, project management, or production management.



Experience working with **video editors, creative agencies, marketing teams, content production, or e-commerce brands** is a major advantage.



Experience with **ClickUp** is also highly preferred.



## About Our Creative Team



Our Creative Strategists develop advertising concepts and scripts.



Our editors execute those concepts into finished advertisements.



We primarily produce:



- AI UGC advertisements

- AI VSLs

- Direct-response video ads

- Short-form advertising content



We're scaling toward approximately **400 videos per week**, which means building an excellent editing talent network is extremely important to us.



You will be the person responsible for helping us build that network.



## Compensation



**$1,300–$1,700 USD/month**, depending on experience.



This is a full-time, long-term position.



We are willing to pay toward the top of the range for someone who has successfully managed recruiting, creative operations, contractors, or production teams before.



There is significant room to grow as the editing organization becomes larger.



## How to Apply



Please answer these questions:



1. Tell us about a role where you managed freelancers, employees, contractors, or candidates.



2. Have you ever recruited video editors, designers, creatives, marketers, or other freelance talent? Explain what you did.



3. Approximately how many people were you responsible for tracking or managing at once?



4. What tools have you used for project management or recruiting? Please specifically mention any experience with ClickUp.



5. Imagine we have 12 editors on trial. Three are performing extremely well, four are average, two aren't receiving enough work from their creative strategist, and three are consistently late. How would you manage the situation?



6. Tell us about a process or system you created or improved in a previous job.



7. Send us a short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why this role interests you.

title: DaVinci Resolve (Video Editor) Marketing Focused
description:
# Marketing Video Editor



**Full-Time Remote | Philippines | $850–$1,000 USD Per Month**



Do Not Apply without sending a personal introduction video about yourself.



## About the Role



We are looking for a creative, reliable and marketing-focused **Video Editor** to join our team full-time.



This role is for an editor who understands that great video editing is not just about making content look polished.



The purpose of the videos we create is to **capture attention, build trust, communicate value and make it easier for businesses to generate enquiries and sales.**



You will edit content for business owners and professional service companies, including:



- Direct-response video advertisements

- Customer testimonials

- Case studies

- Founder and talking-head content

- Short-form social media videos

- Long-form educational and YouTube content



You must be highly confident using **DaVinci Resolve** and comfortable working with professional editing workflows, including multicam footage, proxies, transcripts, audio, colour correction and organised project timelines.



You should also have a strong understanding of **marketing and direct-response principles**.



We are not looking for an editor who simply waits for timestamps and instructions for every cut.



We want someone who can understand the purpose of a video, review raw footage and make intelligent editing decisions based on the message we are trying to communicate.



## Key Responsibilities



- Edit short-form videos for Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts

- Edit direct-response video advertisements designed to generate leads and sales

- Edit customer testimonials and case studies designed to build trust

- Edit long-form interviews, founder videos and educational content

- Edit primarily using **DaVinci Resolve**

- Work confidently with multicam timelines, proxies, synced audio and professional project structures

- Use transcript-based editing where appropriate to identify and remove unnecessary sections

- Review interviews and raw footage to identify strong hooks, claims, objections, stories and persuasive moments

- Turn long interviews and recordings into concise, structured videos with a clear central message

- Understand the main idea behind a video and select supporting footage that strengthens that idea

- Improve pacing without removing important context or meaning

- Add captions, graphics, music, sound design, B-roll and visual elements where appropriate

- Create multiple advertisement variations, hooks and openings for creative testing

- Follow client brand guidelines, templates and established editing styles

- Maintain organised DaVinci Resolve projects, timelines, media and file structures

- Complete revisions accurately and within agreed deadlines

- Communicate clearly with the team about progress, questions and potential delays

- Suggest stronger hooks, structures or editing approaches when you identify opportunities to improve a video



## Essential Requirements



- Strong professional experience using **DaVinci Resolve**

- DaVinci Resolve must be your primary or one of your main editing platforms

- Previous professional video-editing experience

- Strong understanding of marketing-focused video content

- Experience editing direct-response advertisements, lead-generation videos or sales-focused content

- Understanding of hooks, retention, offers, calls to action and customer objections

- Ability to understand the difference between editing for entertainment and editing to influence a business outcome

- Strong short-form editing skills

- Experience editing talking-head videos, interviews, testimonials or case studies

- Ability to review long recordings and independently identify the strongest sections

- Strong understanding of pacing and narrative structure

- Experience working with multicamera footage

- Experience syncing external audio and camera footage

- Comfortable working with proxy workflows

- Basic colour correction and audio-cleanup skills inside DaVinci Resolve

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Excellent attention to detail, particularly with captions, spelling and grammar

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and editing references

- Reliable internet connection

- Computer capable of handling professional DaVinci Resolve projects

- Ability to work consistently during agreed working hours

- Comfortable receiving feedback and completing revisions



## Preferred Skills



- Experience with **DaVinci Resolve Studio**

- Experience using Blackmagic Cloud or collaborative DaVinci Resolve workflows

- Experience with transcript-based editing inside DaVinci Resolve

- Experience editing Meta, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn or YouTube advertisements

- Understanding of direct-response copywriting

- Understanding of customer psychology and buyer objections

- Experience working with agencies, professional service companies, coaches or consultants

- Experience editing testimonials and case studies around one clear marketing message

- Ability to identify strong soundbites without being provided timestamps

- Experience creating several hooks or creative variations from the same footage

- Motion graphics experience

- Basic Fusion knowledge

- Basic audio mixing and sound-design skills

- Interest in marketing, advertising or progressing towards creative strategy



## The Type of Editor We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the timeline.



For example, when editing a customer testimonial, we do not simply want every positive thing the customer says included in the video.



We want the editor to identify:



- What is the main idea this testimonial should communicate?

- What does the potential customer need to believe?

- What problem or objection does this section of the interview address?

- Which clips strengthen the central message?

- Which sections are repetitive or unnecessary?

- What should the viewer understand or feel by the end of the video?



The same applies to advertisements.



A visually impressive edit does not automatically make an effective advertisement.



You should understand that sometimes a simple edit with a strong hook, clear message and persuasive structure will perform better than an edit filled with effects.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful editor in this role will:



- Deliver work on time without needing to be repeatedly chased

- Understand the marketing objective behind each video

- Understand the main message before beginning an edit

- Independently identify strong moments from raw footage

- Produce organised DaVinci Resolve projects

- Maintain clean timelines and file structures

- Produce accurate captions with minimal mistakes

- Follow established editing styles consistently

- Improve quickly after receiving feedback

- Communicate early when clarification is needed

- Suggest improvements when they identify a stronger hook, structure or creative direction

- Become faster and more independent over time

- Eventually require less detailed instruction because they understand our marketing approach



## Salary and Benefits



- **$850–$1,000 USD per month**

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Paid probationary period

- Paid annual leave

- Philippine public holidays

- Regular performance and salary reviews

- Training in direct-response marketing, customer psychology and creative strategy

- Training in our internal editing and storytelling frameworks

- Opportunity to progress into a Senior Video Editor or Creative Strategist role



## Working Hours



This is a full-time position.



Applicants must be available during agreed working hours and should not be working another full-time role at the same time.



Some flexibility may be available, but reliable daily communication and consistent availability are essential.



## Application Process



Please include the following when applying:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience

2. Your portfolio or examples of previous work

3. Examples of marketing videos, advertisements, testimonials or case studies you have edited

4. Details of your experience using **DaVinci Resolve**

5. How long you have been using DaVinci Resolve professionally

6. Whether you currently use DaVinci Resolve Studio

7. Your experience working with multicam footage, proxies and external audio

8. Your current employment situation and availability

9. Your internet speed and computer specifications

10. Your expected start date



Please also answer the following questions:



**1. What is the difference between editing a video to look good and editing a video to generate leads or sales?**

title: Tech Savvy AI Receptionist Builder & Research Assistant: Self-Starter (Voice AI / Automation)
description:
About Ruyen AI



Hi! I'm Asad, founder of Ruyen AI, a UK company that provides AI receptionists to wedding venues.



Wedding venues get a lot of phone calls from couples asking about dates, prices and viewings. Many of these calls get missed because staff are busy, and every missed call can mean a lost booking worth thousands of pounds. Our AI receptionists answer every call, 24/7, and handle these enquiries automatically.



I focus on sales and finding clients. I'm looking for someone to be my right hand: someone who builds the AI receptionists and supports me with research and ideas to help grow the business.



Tools We Use (and Why)



Ulio AI is our main platform for building the AI receptionists. This is where you'll create each receptionist, write its instructions, add the venue's information and set up how it handles calls.

Claude AI is your AI assistant for the work. Use it to write and improve receptionist scripts, solve problems when you're stuck, and speed up research. It's like having an expert on hand 24/7.


 is our booking system. Each receptionist connects to

Skool is an online community of people building AI businesses, with a mentor. When you have a question or get stuck, you can ask there and learn from people who've already solved the same problem.

Google Workspace is for everyday work: Gmail for
, Google Sheets for client lists and research, Google Docs for notes and summaries, and Google Drive to store everything.



All access will be provided.



How a Build Works

Connect the tools. Link the phone number, and connect 
 so the AI can book viewings directly into the venue's calendar.

Hand it over by sending me a short summary of what you built and anything I should know.



You will learn Ulio AI using the resources provided. I won't be training you step by step, so you must be comfortable figuring things out yourself.



Research and Support Tasks



Alongside building, you will:



Find potential clients by researching UK wedding venues and collecting their names, websites, phone numbers and
s into a Google Sheet.

Research the market for trends, opportunities and problems wedding venues have.

Help with other business tasks as they come up.



I want someone who thinks ahead, spots opportunities and tells me what they think, not someone who only follows instructions.



The Kind of Person I'm Looking For

Honest. If something isn't working or you've made a mistake, you tell me straight away so we can fix it.

Curious about AI. You enjoy learning new tools and keep up with what's new, because AI changes fast.

Trustworthy. You handle client information carefully and keep it confidential.



Key Skills Required

You're a proven self-learner. You have taught yourself new software or tools before, with no one showing you how. You know how to use YouTube, AI tools, help guides and online communities to figure things out and get results.

title: Digital Marketing & Paid Ads Specialist
description:
KnockOut Branding is a U.S.-based branded merchandise and apparel company helping organizations strengthen their culture through intentional branded products, employee merchandise, corporate gifting, company stores and branded experiences.



We are growing and looking for a Digital Marketing & Paid Ads Specialist who can help us build a predictable pipeline of qualified B2B opportunities.



This is not a general administrative VA position. We are looking for someone who understands digital marketing, thinks strategically, works independently and is comfortable being accountable for measurable results.



 The Role

You will help execute and optimize KnockOut Branding's digital lead-generation strategy, with an initial focus on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads



You will work directly with company leadership to turn our target markets, offers and positioning into campaigns that generate qualified leads and discovery calls.



Our ideal candidate doesn't just launch campaigns and report numbers. You look at the data, identify what is and isn't working, recommend changes and continuously improve performance.



Key Responsibilities:

LinkedIn Advertising



* Build and manage campaigns in LinkedIn Campaign Manager

* Develop highly targeted B2B audiences based on:



  * Industry

  * Company size

  * Geography

  * Job title

  * Job function

  * Seniority

* Build and optimize LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms

* Create retargeting campaigns

* Test audiences, offers, copy and creative

* Monitor campaign performance and make ongoing optimizations

* Track cost per lead and, more importantly, **cost per qualified lead**



Google Ads



* Support and manage Google Search campaigns

* Conduct keyword research

* Build targeted ad groups

* Write and test ad copy

* Manage negative keywords

* Monitor search terms and campaign quality

* Optimize campaigns for qualified B2B conversions



Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization



* Help build and improve campaign landing pages

* Make recommendations to improve conversion rates

* Create and test calls-to-action, headlines and offers

* Ensure tracking is installed and functioning correctly



HubSpot & Lead Tracking



* Ensure leads flow correctly into HubSpot

* Maintain campaign attribution and tracking

* Help build simple lead-nurture workflows

* Track leads from initial inquiry through discovery call and opportunity

* Help us understand which campaigns are actually generating revenue



Creative & Content Execution



* Create professional ad graphics using Canva or similar tools

* Resize and adapt existing brand assets for campaigns

* Write or refine short-form ad copy

* Develop multiple creative variations for testing

* Maintain consistency with KnockOut Branding's visual identity and voice



Reporting & Optimization



Provide a clear weekly marketing scorecard that includes:



* Ad spend

* Impressions

* Click-through rate

* Cost per click

* Leads generated

* Cost per lead

* Qualified leads

* Cost per qualified lead

* Discovery calls booked

* Opportunities generated

* Recommendations for the following week



We want someone who can tell us what the numbers mean and what we should do next, not simply send a spreadsheet.



Our Target Customers



KnockOut Branding primarily sells to established U.S. businesses with approximately 50–1,000+ employees



Priority industries include:



* Law firms

* Construction companies

* Financial services

* Professional services



Common decision-makers include:



* Human Resources

* People & Culture

* Marketing

* Operations

* Office/Workplace Management

* Executive Leadership



Our services include company merchandise programs, employee apparel, corporate gifting, onboarding kits, branded products and managed company stores.



What We're Looking For



Required

* 2+ years of hands-on digital advertising experience

* Experience managing LinkedIn Ads for B2B companies

* Experience with Google Ads

* Strong understanding of B2B lead generation

* Experience with conversion tracking

* Strong analytical skills

* Excellent written English

* Ability to work independently and manage priorities

* Comfortable making recommendations rather than waiting for instructions

* Highly organized and detail-oriented



Strongly Preferred

* HubSpot experience

* Canva experience

* Experience marketing to U.S. businesses

* Experience working with B2B service companies

* Experience building landing pages

* Experience with retargeting

* Experience connecting advertising campaigns to CRM reporting

* Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager



How We Work



Our team values proactive communication, accountability and continuous improvement.

We expect you to:

Take ownership. If something isn't working, investigate it and recommend a solution.

Communicate proactively. Don't wait for us to ask how a campaign is performing.

Use data to make decisions. We care about qualified opportunities and revenue—not vanity metrics.

Keep learning. Digital advertising changes quickly. We want someone who stays current and brings new ideas to the table.

Raise the bar. "Good enough" isn't how we operate.



Schedule

This is a remote position based in the Philippines.

Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be required for team meetings and collaboration, but much of the campaign work can be completed independently.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining your experience with B2B paid advertising

3. Examples of LinkedIn and/or Google Ads campaigns you have personally managed

4. The approximate monthly advertising budgets you have managed

5. Examples of campaign results, including CPL or other relevant performance metrics



Please also answer this question:



**Imagine KnockOut Branding gives you a $3,000 monthly LinkedIn advertising budget. We want to generate qualified discovery calls with HR, Marketing and People leaders at U.S. companies with 50–1,000+ employees. Briefly explain how you would structure your first campaign and what you would test during the first 30 days.**



Please do not use a generic or AI-generated response. We are looking for your actual thought process and experience.

title: Operations & Customer Experience Assistant
description:
Etsy Operations & Customer Experience Assistant



Remote, Philippines | Full Time Contract | 39 paid hours per week | Monday to Saturday | $725 USD per month



Working hours:

Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm UK time

1 hour unpaid lunch break Monday to Friday

Saturday, 9:00am to 1:00pm UK time

Sunday off



Contract fee: $725 USD per month

Payment: Monthly by bank transfer on the 1st of each month, or the first working day if the 1st falls on a weekend or bank holiday

Additional annual payment: One additional month’s contract fee paid in December

Engagement: Full time exclusive contract with DHW Group



About DHW Group



DHW Group is a UK based furniture and ecommerce business.



Our consumer brand, Dave’s Hardwood, specialises in handmade rustic furniture and currently sells primarily through Etsy.



The business has grown quickly and we are now strengthening the operational structure around customer service, order management and ecommerce.



We are looking for an experienced Etsy Operations & Customer Experience Assistant to take ownership of the day to day customer and administrative operation behind Dave’s Hardwood.



This is intended to be a long term role with the opportunity to grow as DHW Group expands.



The Problem We Need You to Solve



The volume of Etsy messages, order queries, shipping checks and customer follow ups has grown significantly.



The challenge is not simply answering messages.



We need someone to make sure:



Every customer message is seen

Every customer receives an accurate response

Every order issue is followed up

Shipping problems are identified early

Promises made to customers are not forgotten

Outstanding issues do not disappear inside Etsy, Outlook or Trello

Customers receive consistent information

Problems are followed through until they are resolved

David and Shani are only interrupted when a genuine decision or urgent intervention is required



Too much senior management time is currently spent checking Etsy, following up orders and making sure nothing has been missed.



We are hiring you to take ownership of that workload.



Every customer issue should have:



An owner

A current status

A clear next action

A deadline where required

A confirmed resolution

What We Are Looking For



This is not an entry level VA position.



Previous professional experience supporting consumers in an ecommerce or online retail environment is required.



Previous Etsy customer service experience is highly desirable.



Training will be provided on DHW Group, Dave’s Hardwood, our products and our internal processes. We are not looking to teach basic customer service from scratch.



We need someone who is:



Highly organised

Independent

Proactive

Calm under pressure

Excellent with customers

Confident working autonomously

Extremely attentive to detail

Comfortable managing several open issues at once

Able to investigate before escalating

Confident making routine decisions within agreed guidelines

Confident enough to speak up when something looks wrong

Comfortable respectfully questioning information or a process that appears incorrect

Not afraid to ask for help when it is genuinely required

Disciplined about following issues through until they are resolved



We do not want someone who waits for instructions.



We also do not want someone who simply forwards every problem to management.



You should naturally think:



What has happened? What have I checked? What can I resolve myself? What needs to happen next? Who owns the next action?



Important Application Instruction



To show us that you have read the full job description carefully, please begin your application with the words:



Perfectly Imperfect



Applications that do not begin with these words may not be considered.



Reporting & Management



You will report directly to:



David Sargant

Managing Director, DHW Group



and



Shani Sohun

Operations Director, DHW Group



You will have direct access to both Directors through Microsoft Teams, our internal WhatsApp group and telephone.



We expect open communication.



If something looks wrong, raise it.



If you can resolve something yourself using the information and authority available to you, do so.



Management should receive decisions to make, not problems to investigate.



Daily Director Check-In



You will have a short daily video check-in with a Director of DHW Group.



This will normally cover:



Urgent customer or operational issues

Anything requiring management input

Important Trello actions

Priorities for the day

Blockers or recurring problems

Risks that need attention



The call should be brief and focused.



You should arrive prepared with the information needed rather than using the call to investigate routine issues.



You must be comfortable communicating clearly in spoken English and appearing on video every working day.



Working Hours & Availability



Your normal schedule is:



Monday to Friday: 9:00am to 5:00pm UK time

Lunch: 1 hour unpaid each weekday

Saturday: 9:00am to 1:00pm UK time

Sunday: Off



This provides 39 paid hours per week.



Saturday is part of the normal working schedule.



Dave’s Hardwood operates an automatic Etsy out of office response between 5:00pm and 9:00am UK time.



At the start of each shift, you will review anything received while the out of office response was active.



You must be actively available throughout your agreed working hours.



Exclusive Full Time Contract



This is an exclusive full time engagement with DHW Group.



You must not undertake other employment, VA positions, freelance work, consulting work or other client contracts during your engagement with DHW Group without prior written approval.



During your agreed DHW Group working hours, your full professional attention must be dedicated to DHW Group.



What You Need to Have



As this is a remote role, you must have:



A professional home working environment

A quiet environment suitable for customer service, telephone and video calls

Reliable high speed internet

A suitable laptop or desktop computer

A working webcam and microphone

The ability to run multiple browser based systems at the same time

Backup internet where possible

A sensible contingency for local power or internet problems

Reliable availability throughout the agreed UK working hours

Fluent written English

Fluent spoken English

Confidence communicating directly with UK based management

Excellent attention to detail

Strong organisational skills

Good judgement

The ability to work independently without constant supervision

The confidence to make routine decisions

The confidence to speak up when necessary



You need to know the difference between:



“I can deal with this myself.”



and



“David or Shani need to know about this.”



Systems & Accounts Provided



DHW Group will provide the systems and business accounts required for the role, including:



A DHW Group business
 address

Microsoft 365

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Teams

Etsy Shared Access

ShipStation access

Trello access

Access to the DHW Group Operations Knowledge Base

Access to approved AI tools

Access to the DHW Group WhatsApp team

Etsy Customer Messages



You will take day to day ownership of the Dave’s Hardwood Etsy customer inbox.



You will:



Monitor Etsy Messages throughout your shift

Review messages received outside working hours

Respond to routine customer enquiries

Read the full conversation before replying

Check the associated order where relevant

Make sure customers receive accurate and consistent information

Follow up unresolved conversations

Identify messages requiring escalation

Make sure no customer message is forgotten

Keep response times under control



Customer communication should be warm, natural and professional.



We do not want robotic, overly formal or obviously copied customer service responses.



Accuracy Comes First



Accuracy is more important than speed.



If you cannot verify something, do not tell the customer it is true.



Never guess a dispatch date, delivery date, refund decision, replacement decision or product detail.



Etsy Shared Access



You will receive your own authorised access to the Dave’s Hardwood Etsy shop through Etsy Shared Access.



Your permissions will primarily include:



Managing orders

Communicating with buyers



You will not have permission to publish or edit listings unless specifically authorised.



You must never request, use or share the shop owner’s primary Etsy login details.



Order & ShipStation Monitoring



You will monitor Etsy orders and proactively identify potential problems.



This includes:



Checking whether orders have been dispatched

Identifying orders approaching their dispatch deadline

Identifying overdue orders

Checking order status against ShipStation

Checking that tracking information is present

Identifying differences between Etsy and ShipStation

Identifying delayed shipments or tracking exceptions

Identifying shipments that appear to have stopped moving

Flagging orders requiring investigation

Following unresolved shipping issues through to completion



You will not create shipping labels.



ShipStation is the main shipping system you will monitor.



Always work from the information available in our systems.



Never guess where a parcel is or when it will arrive.



Shared Outlook Mailbox



You will monitor our shared Etsy support mailbox.



This receives important Etsy and operational notifications.



You will:



Review incoming notifications

Identify important Etsy
s

Identify order related notifications

Flag Etsy account warnings or unusual activity

Make sure anything requiring action is handled

Add unresolved actions to Trello



Outlook should not become another task management system.



If an
 creates an action, either resolve it or put the action into Trello.



Trello



Trello is our primary internal system for managing outstanding work.



Anything that cannot be fully resolved immediately should be recorded in Trello.



You will:



Create cards for unresolved issues

Add the customer name and Etsy order number

Clearly explain the issue

Record the current status

Record the latest action taken

Record the next action

Assign the correct person

Add deadlines where required

Keep cards updated

Review overdue cards

Chase outstanding actions

Close cards only when an issue is genuinely resolved



Escalating something does not mean your responsibility ends.



You remain responsible for monitoring it until it is resolved.



How We Use Our Systems



Etsy

Customer communication and order information



ShipStation

Shipping and tracking information



Trello

Internal tasks, unresolved issues and follow ups



Outlook

Business, Etsy and operational notifications



DHW Group Knowledge Base

How we handle common situations



Teams, WhatsApp and telephone

Direct communication and urgent escalation



Your job is to connect these systems without creating another layer of unnecessary administration.



Knowledge Base & AI



You will have access to an AI supported DHW Group Operations Knowledge Base containing approved information on areas including:



Dave’s Hardwood products

Shelf sizes

Finishes

Brackets and fixings

Customer service procedures

Etsy procedures

ShipStation procedures

Shipping issues

Returns

Refunds

Replacements

Damaged products

Trello processes

Escalation rules

Approved customer response guidance



You should consult the knowledge base before escalating routine questions.



Approved AI tools may also be used to:



Draft customer replies

Summarise long conversations

Improve written communication

Identify the main issue

Structure responses

Check documented procedures

Prioritise work

Important AI Rule



AI must never be allowed to invent information on behalf of DHW Group.



If something cannot be confirmed through the knowledge base or our business systems, escalate it.



You remain responsible for checking the accuracy of anything sent to a customer.



Typical Customer Enquiries



You will deal with enquiries including:



Where is my order?

When will my order dispatch?

Delivery and tracking questions

Delivery delays

Product sizes

Shelf finishes and colours

Brackets and fixings

Damaged products

Missing items

Replacement enquiries

Custom order questions

Product care

Natural wood variation



Routine enquiries should increasingly be handled independently once training is complete.



Escalation



Before escalating an issue, you should normally check:



The Etsy order

The full customer conversation

Dispatch information

ShipStation

Existing Trello history

The internal knowledge base



Your escalation should explain:



What has happened

What you have checked

What action has already been taken

What decision is required

Your recommended next action where appropriate



For genuinely urgent situations, you should contact David or Shani directly.



Issues That Must Be Escalated



These include:



Refund requests requiring approval

Cancellation requests

Etsy cases

Chargebacks

Threats of negative reviews

Customers threatening to report the business

Aggressive or abusive customers

Etsy account warnings

Etsy policy issues

Etsy Trust & Safety contact

Damaged orders requiring replacement approval

Missing parcels

Compensation requests

Incorrect products being sent

Serious shipping failures

Anything that could affect Etsy account health

Anything where you genuinely do not know the correct action



If you are unsure, escalate.



Never guess.



Customer Promises



Any commitment made to a customer must be followed through.



For example:



“We will update you tomorrow”

“We are checking your order”

“A replacement will be sent”

“We will speak to the workshop”

“Your refund is awaiting approval”



If a customer is waiting for something from us, there should be a corresponding action in Trello.



Daily Routine

Start of Shift



You will:



Review new Etsy messages

Review the shared Outlook mailbox

Review open and overdue Trello cards

Check unresolved issues from the previous shift

Identify orders approaching dispatch deadlines

Check outstanding shipping issues

Prepare any points requiring management input

Attend the daily video check-in with a Director

Throughout the Day



You will:



Monitor Etsy Messages

Resolve routine enquiries

Update Trello

Check ShipStation where required

Follow up outstanding actions

Chase internal actions where necessary

Escalate genuinely urgent issues

Keep unresolved issues moving

End of Shift



Before finishing, you will:



Make sure no important customer message has been forgotten

Review open Trello cards

Make sure every open card has a clear next action

Review urgent issues

Highlight anything requiring management input

Ensure anything awaiting further action remains visible and owned

Training



Training will be provided on:



DHW Group

Dave’s Hardwood

Our products

Our Etsy operation

Customer service standards

Trello

ShipStation

Outlook

Escalation processes

Internal procedures

The knowledge base

Common customer situations



The purpose of training is to teach you how DHW Group operates, not basic customer service.



Experience Required



Previous professional experience supporting consumers in ecommerce or online retail is required.



We need to see this clearly reflected in your application.



Previous Etsy customer service experience is highly desirable.



Experience with any of the following is useful:



Etsy

ShipStation

Trello

Microsoft 365

Outlook

Microsoft Teams

Shopify

ChatGPT or similar AI tools



We care more about what you have actually done than simply which systems appear on your CV.



Protecting the Customer & the Business



Good customer service is important, but so is good judgement.



You should understand that your role helps protect:



The customer experience

The reputation of Dave’s Hardwood

The health of our Etsy account

The time of the management team

The wider DHW Group business



The correct answer is not always simply the fastest answer.



Career Progression



This role initially focuses on the Dave’s Hardwood Etsy operation.



We are also preparing to grow our direct to consumer business through our own website.



As the business grows, there will be an opportunity for this role to expand into wider Customer Support and Ecommerce Operations.



This may include:



Supporting customers purchasing through our website

Managing website customer enquiries

Supporting Shopify orders

Providing support across multiple sales channels

Helping develop customer service procedures

Supporting additional DHW Group ecommerce activity

Taking greater responsibility for the wider customer experience function



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with DHW Group.



What Success Looks Like



Success means David and Shani no longer need to constantly check Etsy to make sure everything is being handled.



You will be measured on:



Etsy messages being consistently monitored

No unexplained unanswered customer messages

Accurate customer responses

Dispatch risks identified early

Shipping problems identified through ShipStation

Outstanding issues correctly managed in Trello

Quality of escalation

Issues followed through until resolution

Customer commitments followed up

Minimal unnecessary management interruptions

Correct use of the knowledge base

Strong attention to detail

Independent problem solving

No unauthorised refunds, cancellations or compensation



Our goal is simple:



Every customer message should be seen, every problem should have an owner and nothing important should be forgotten.



How to Apply



We expect to receive a high number of applications.



To progress to interview, your application must clearly demonstrate relevant experience in consumer customer service, ecommerce or Etsy operations.



We are particularly interested in candidates who have:



Managed customer enquiries for a consumer ecommerce business

Worked directly with consumers

Managed an Etsy store or Etsy customer inbox

Handled delivery and tracking enquiries

Dealt with complaints, damaged products, refunds or replacements

Managed a busy customer support inbox

Taken ownership of customer issues through to resolution



Generic applications that do not demonstrate relevant experience are unlikely to progress.



Please include:



A short introduction about yourself

Your previous consumer customer service experience

Your previous ecommerce experience

Details of any previous Etsy experience

Examples of the types of customer enquiries or problems you have personally handled

Your experience with Trello

Your experience with ShipStation or similar shipping systems

Other ecommerce or customer support systems you have used

Your current internet speed

Your computer specifications

Details of your professional home working environment

Confirmation that you can work the stated UK hours including Saturday

Confirmation that you are able to work exclusively for DHW Group

Your earliest available start date

Video Introduction



Where possible, please include a short 1 to 3 minute video introduction.



It does not need to be professionally produced.



Please briefly tell us:



Who you are

Your most relevant consumer customer service or ecommerce experience

Any Etsy experience you have

Why you think you would be a good fit for the role



This position involves regular communication with UK based management and a daily video check-in with a Director.



Applicants who include a video introduction will be prioritised when we shortlist for interview.



Application Questions



Please answer the following:



1. A customer says their order should have arrived yesterday but ShipStation still shows the parcel in transit. What would you do before replying?



2. You have assigned a Trello card to the Operations Director but have not received a response and the customer is waiting. What would you do?



3. An AI tool gives you an answer to a customer question but you cannot confirm the information in the company knowledge base. What would you do?



4. A customer sends an angry Etsy message threatening to leave a negative review because their order is late. Explain how you would handle the situation.



5. At 4:45pm on Friday you notice an unresolved Trello card relating to an order that should have dispatched that day. What would you do?



6. Tell us about a time you spotted a customer or operational problem before your manager raised it. What did you do?



7. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a manager or noticed that an existing process was wrong. How did you handle it?



8. Customer response test:

A customer sends the following Etsy message:



“This was supposed to arrive yesterday and I’ve heard nothing. This is really disappointing.”



Write the actual response you would send to the customer. Do not assume any information that has not been provided.



Recruitment Process



Applications will initially be reviewed for:



Relevant consumer customer service experience

Ecommerce and Etsy experience

Written English

Attention to detail

Independent problem solving

Quality of the application

Quality of the application question responses

Video introduction where provided



We are looking for evidence of what you have actually done, not simply a list of software you have used.



Candidates who progress will be invited to a first stage video interview with a Director of DHW Group.



The interview will focus on:



Your consumer customer service experience

Your Etsy and ecommerce experience

How you deal with difficult customers

How you investigate problems

How you organise and prioritise work

How independently you are comfortable working

How you d
 when to act yourself and when to escalate

Your communication style

Your understanding of the role



Practical scenario based questions may also be included.



Best,



David

Managing Director

DHW Group

title: Senior Digital Marketing Account Manager for US Agency – Part-Time
description:
20 Hours/Week | $15–$20 USD/Hour



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager who has worked inside a digital marketing agency and is comfortable independently managing clients, solving problems, and coordinating a team of specialists.



This is not a virtual assistant or entry-level project management position.



We already have team members who handle administrative work and specialists who execute SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, websites, automation and other marketing services.



What we need is an experienced person who can sit between our clients and our production team, take ownership of problems, and make sure things get solved without everything needing to go through the agency owner.



## What You'll Do



- Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients.

- Understand what a client is actually trying to accomplish when they submit a request or raise a problem.

- Manage website projects, revisions and client feedback.

- Coordinate SEO, paid advertising, website, CRM and other marketing work with our specialists.

- Review work and identify problems before it reaches the client.

- Help clients work through marketing questions and make reasonable recommendations.

- Handle difficult or unhappy client situations professionally.

- Turn client needs into clear assignments for the appropriate team members.

- Keep projects moving and make sure commitments and deadlines aren't forgotten.

- Work with our Client Success Coordinator, who assists with routine communication, follow-up and administrative tasks.

- Escalate issues to the owner when they truly require senior strategic involvement—not simply because something is unfamiliar.



 What We're Looking For



You should have several years of experience working with clients at a digital marketing agency.



You don't need to personally execute every marketing service, but you should understand enough about digital marketing to intelligently manage specialists and clients.



You should be comfortable discussing and managing projects involving:



- SEO and content marketing

- Website design and development

- Website UX, navigation and conversion

- Google Ads and Meta Ads

- CRM and marketing automation

- Lead generation

- Analytics and marketing performance



Experience with GoHighLevel and ClickUp is helpful but not required.



The Most Important Part of This Job



We are looking for someone who takes ownership.



If a client says:



"I'm not happy with my new website."



We don't want you to simply forward the message to the owner.



We want you to speak with the client, understand the problem, evaluate what needs to change, coordinate with the appropriate team members, and move the issue toward a solution.



If a client has a technical problem, you don't necessarily need to personally fix it. But you should be able to determine who needs to be involved, get the right people working on it, communicate with the client, and make sure it gets resolved.



You should be comfortable encountering situations where there isn't an existing SOP and using good judgment to determine the next step.



About Us



We operate two related marketing businesses serving approximately 75 clients.



One specializes in marketing for charter captains, tour operators and other marine tourism businesses. The other works with a smaller group of established businesses in several industries.



Our team includes specialists in SEO, paid advertising, web development, automation and marketing operations.



The owner is transitioning away from day-to-day account management to focus primarily on strategy, sales and business development.



A major measure of success in this position will be your ability to independently handle the day-to-day client and marketing issues that would otherwise require the owner's involvement.



 Schedule & Compensation



This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week.



There is definitely an opportunity to go full time for the right person



Compensation: $15–$20 USD per hour, depending on experience.



There is potential for the role and hours to grow as the company grows.



To Apply



Please include:



1. A voice recording

2. How many years you've worked for a digital marketing agency.

3. How many clients/accounts you personally managed at one time.

4. Which marketing services you have experience managing.

5. Your desired hourly rate.



Please begin your application with the words "ACCOUNT OWNER" so we know you've read the complete job description.

title: Social Media Manager (Remote, UK)
description:

We are looking for a highly experienced, strategic, and creative Social Media Manager to take full ownership of our social media presence across two growing businesses: a property-focused company and a fast-growing consumer card game brand.



This is a leadership role, not a junior or execution-only position. You will be responsible for strategy, performance, team leadership, training, and measurable growth, with a clear focus on brand awareness, engagement, and commercial results.



The Role

As Social Media Manager, you will:

• Own and deliver the end-to-end social media strategy across all platforms

• Lead, manage, and develop a team of four social media executives

• Design and implement a clear training, coaching, and performance framework for the team

• Plan and oversee content strategy, campaigns, and brand storytelling

• Ensure all content aligns with brand values, tone of voice, and commercial objectives

• Drive organic growth, engagement, reach, and audience retention

• Use analytics and insights to measure performance and continuously improve results

• Collaborate with leadership on product launches, promotions, and sales campaigns

• Manage posting schedules, workflows, and quality control

• Stay ahead of trends, platform changes, and algorithm updates

• Protect and enhance brand reputation across all channels



Essential Skills & Experience

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate impact, not just activity.



You must have:

• Strong experience managing multiple platforms (Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, etc.)

• Experience leading and developing a team

• Advanced understanding of social media analytics, insights, and reporting

• Ability to turn data into actionable strategy

• Excellent copywriting, storytelling, and content direction skills

• Strong organisational and project management skills

• Commercial awareness — understanding how social media supports sales and brand growth

• Confidence working with senior leadership and making strategic recommendations



Desirable (But Not Essential)

• Experience within property, lifestyle, consumer products, or gaming brands

• Experience supporting product launches or e-commerce

• Experience building or scaling a brand from early-stage growth



Working Hours - 16 hours per week across 4 days on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00 UK time.

title: Accounts Assistant (Remote, UK)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Assistant to support the day-to-day financial operations of our property lettings and management business. This role focuses on allocating and reconciling rental transactions, preparing payment runs, landlord statements, rent arrears monitoring, maintaining financial trackers, and supporting monthly financial reporting, working closely with the Business Support Manager and the Property Management team.

The ideal candidate will be highly organised, methodical, and comfortable working with spreadsheets and property management systems, with a strong focus on accuracy and follow-through.



Key Responsibilities

Rental Accounts & Daily Transactions

• Allocate rental payments to the correct rental accounts using bank statements provided by the Business Support Manager

• Ensure all rental income is accurately recorded and reconciled on a daily basis

• Identify and flag discrepancies or missing payments promptly

Payment Runs

• Prepare payment run files twice per week, including:

o Management fee & property maintenance charge deductions

o Contractor payments

o Deposit refunds

• Ensure figures are accurate, properly approved, and aligned with supporting records

Landlord Statements

• Allocate and reconcile payments in the property management system (AMC) prior to issuing landlord statements

• Prepare and issue:

o Monthly statements for specific landlords where system-generated statements are not yet available

o Statements in Excel/Word format for landlords with multiple properties

o Commercial property statements on a quarterly basis

• Ensure statements are accurate, clear, and issued in a timely manner

Invoicing

• Raise invoices to landlords, tenants, or third parties when required

• Track invoice status and follow up where necessary

Rent Arrears Monitoring

• Check rent received against Rent Due Dates (RDD) daily

• Maintain and update the rent arrears tracker

• Liaise with the Property Management team regarding long-standing or unresolved arrears

• Escalate issues to the Business Support Manager where appropriate

Property Maintenance Charges, Trackers & Short-Term Rental Setup Costs

• Maintain and regularly update multiple trackers relating to property maintenance charges and costs, including:

o Contractor invoices

o Maintenance costs per property

o Rechargeable vs non-rechargeable items

• Ensure all maintenance charges are accurately recorded, tracked, and aligned with invoices and landlord statements

• Flag missing invoices, discrepancies, or unusually high costs to the Business Support Manager

• Support reconciliation of maintenance charges during payment runs and statement preparation

• Track and maintain records of setup costs for short-term rental properties, including initial furnishing, setup, and onboarding expenses

• Maintain a clear setup cost tracker per short-term rental property to support financial reviews and performance analysis

Monthly Reporting & Balance Sheet

• Prepare monthly balance sheets by reviewing income streams and expenses

• Support internal financial reporting and data accuracy

Financial Review & Planning Support

• Assist with periodic reviews of the company’s financial position and property portfolio

• Support financial analysis relating to deal performance and growth targets 

Company Finance Administration

• Support periodic company bank questionnaires and compliance checks

• Assist with company credit card applications and monitor ongoing spending and perks

• Provide required financial information to external accountants for annual tax filings

Compliance & Deal Audit Checks

• Carry out audit checks on compliance documentation (e.g. gas safety certificate, required property documents) to ensure records are complete and up to date

• Support audit checks on new deals, confirming that key financial and compliance information has been captured correctly

• Maintain audit trackers and flag missing, expired, or inconsistent documentation to the Business Support Manager

• Liaise with the Property Management team to resolve gaps or discrepancies identified during audit reviews



Skills & Experience Required

• Previous experience in an accounts assistant or finance support role

• Proven experience working remotely for an overseas company, preferably supporting a UK-based business

• Comfortable working to committed UK working hours, with the ability to manage tasks, deadlines, and communication across time zones

• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

• Confident working with:

o Excel / spreadsheets (including trackers)

o Payment allocations and reconciliations

o Accounting or property management systems (training provided if required)

• Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple trackers and recurring tasks

• Good time-management and prioritisation skills

• Clear written communication skills

• Able to work independently while maintaining regular communication with the Business Support Manager

title: Caregiver Recruiting & Sourcing VA
description:
From The Heart Home Care, LLC is a dedicated home care agency committed to providing compassionate, high-quality care that allows seniors and individuals to remain safe, comfortable, and independent in their own homes.



We are passionate about matching our clients with dependable, caring, and professional caregivers who make a positive difference in the lives of those we serve. As we continue to grow, we are seeking motivated team members who can help us attract and hire outstanding caregivers to support our expanding client base across South Carolina.



As a Caregiver Recruiting & Sourcing VA, you will play a vital role in helping our organization recruit, screen, and coordinate qualified caregiver candidates. Your efforts will directly impact our ability to provide exceptional care by ensuring we maintain a strong pipeline of top-quality caregivers.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



*Candidate Sourcing



Post caregiver job ads on
, Indeed, and other job boards

Source qualified caregiver candidates through online platforms and referrals

Build and maintain a pipeline of caregiver applicants

Respond to candidate inquiries in a timely manner



*Candidate Screening



Review applications and resumes

Conduct initial phone screenings

Verify caregiver experience, availability, and qualifications

Assess communication skills and overall fit for the position

Recommend qualified candidates for interviews



*Interview Coordination



Schedule interviews with recruiters, coordinators, and hiring managers

Send interview invitations and reminders

Confirm candidate attendance

Follow up on missed interviews and rescheduling requests



*Recruitment Administration

Maintain accurate applicant records and tracking spreadsheets

Update candidate statuses throughout the hiring process

Document screening notes and recruitment activities

Assist with onboarding document collection when needed

Ensure recruitment data is organized and up to date



*Reporting and Follow-Up

Track applications, screenings, interviews, and hires

Generate recruitment reports and hiring updates

Follow up with candidates regarding next steps

Help maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Strong organizational and multitasking skills

title: Business Support Coordinator (Accounts & Compliance) - UK Remote
description:
This role will need to work in UK hours.



Job Overview

The Business Support Coordinator provides essential support across Finance & Accounting, UK lettings compliance, and business administration within a busy letting and property management company.



This role is primarily focused on financial administration (50%), with significant responsibility for compliance support (35%), and a smaller contribution to administrative and project work (15%). The role supports multiple teams and works extensively with industry platforms including GNB, Goodlord, FCC Paragon, MyDeposits, Excel-based accounting tools, and major property portals.



This is a coordinator-level position, ideal for someone highly organised, detail-oriented, and keen to develop practical experience in property finance and compliance 

to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently within a fast-paced remote environment.



Key Responsibilities

Finance & Accounting Support (50%)

• Process supplier invoices, receipts, and expense claims using Excel-based accounting trackers and internal systems.

• Assist with preparing and coordinating payment runs, ensuring all documentation and approvals are in place.

• Prepare landlord invoices and rent statements accurately and on time.

• Confirm receipt of tenant funds, including move-in monies, and record payments correctly.

• Update rent accounts and assist with basic reconciliations.

• Maintain and update the rent arrears list, flagging overdue accounts to the Property Management team.

• Support updates to P&L support schedules and finance trackers in Excel.

• Respond to routine finance-related queries from internal teams and escalate issues where appropriate.

• Assist with ad-hoc accounting and finance administration tasks as required.



Compliance Support & Documentation (35%)

• Assist with checking landlord and tenant documentation for compliance with UK lettings regulations.

• Support compliance workflows using Goodlord, FCC Paragon, and GNB, ensuring all required documents are completed and correctly stored.

• Maintain accurate digital filing of compliance documents within shared folders and property management systems.

• Identify missing, expired, or incomplete documents and follow up with relevant parties.

• Support post-move-in compliance checks, ensuring documentation is uploaded and audit-ready.

• Assist with deposit registration and compliance via My Deposits, ensuring prescribed information is issued and recorded correctly.

• Track compliance deadlines (e.g. safety certificates, prescribed information, tenancy documentation) and flag upcoming renewals.

• Assist in preparing compliance records for internal reviews or audits.



Administration & Project Support (15%)

• Provide general administrative support to the Operations, Finance, and Compliance teams.

• Assist with maintaining company templates, forms, and standard documents, ensuring the correct versions are in use.

• Support tracking of company certifications, memberships, and renewal dates.

• Assist with internal projects such as system updates, process improvements, audits, or data validation exercises.

• Carry out other reasonable administrative duties as assigned.



Key Skills & Qualifications

Essential

• Experience in an administrative or coordinator role.

• Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

• Confident working with Microsoft Excel.

• Organised and methodical approach to work.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Ability to handle confidential financial and personal data appropriately.

• Willingness to learn property finance and compliance systems.

Desirable

• Experience within a UK letting agent or property management company.

• Previous exposure to Goodlord, FCC Paragon, GNB, or MyDeposits.

• Experience working in a fast-paced or remote team environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly detail-oriented and accurate

• Reliable, professional, and discreet

• Proactive with a willingness to learn

• Strong team player with a supportive attitude

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist (AI Savvy)
description:
Full-time | Remote | $4,000/month OTE (uncapped)



ABOUT US

11x Leads is a lead generation advertising agency running paid acquisition on Meta 
 and Instagram) for financial services brands: mortgages, loans and similar products.



Our offers are proven. At scale, the ads you create will have $100,000–$300,000 a month in spend running through them. This is a real chance to build serious proof of your work at a growing company.



THE ROLE

You'll own Meta ad creative end to end: video and static. You'll use state-of-the-art AI video and image models (all paid for by us) plus our existing workflows, which already produce a range of ad formats. You d
 what gets made, make it fast, and make it win.



You don't launch or manage campaigns. You focus purely on creative, with full access to all creative performance data.



You're measured on one thing above all: how much spend runs profitably through your ads at or below target CPL.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Iterate on winners: study what's performing, work out why (hook, angle, format, offer, visual) and produce variations that scale it

- Take big swings: pitch and produce entirely new concepts, angles and formats

- Produce video ads for
 and Instagram using AI video models and our existing workflows

- Produce high-quality static ads using AI image models and design tools

- Structure creative tests so every batch teaches us something

- Stay current on new AI models and techniques and bring them into the workflow



TARGETS

- Primary: profitable spend through your creative at or below target CPL

- Secondary: minimum 20–30 video ads and 20–30 high-quality statics per week



WHAT YOU NEED

- Proven experience creating AI-generated video ads that have run with paid spend. This is non-negotiable.

- Hands-on experience with current AI video and image models

- Strong understanding of Meta ad creative: placements, formats, aspect ratios, and what stops the scroll on
 and Instagram

- Direct-response instincts: hooks, angles, offers, and why ads convert

- Comfort reading ad data (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CPL) and turning it into creative decisions

- Speed and organisation. You'll ship 40–60+ assets a week.

- Strong written and spoken English

- No financial services experience needed. We'll teach you the categories.



NICE TO HAVE

- Performance creative experience in lead gen

- Editing and design skills (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, Figma, Photoshop)

- Experience with automation tools such as n8n



HOURS

Fully remote. You must be available for at least 5 hours between 9am and 4pm UK time, Monday to Friday.



COMPENSATION

- Base: $3,000/month

- Performance bonus: target around $1,000/month, uncapped

- How the bonus works: every ad has a target CPL. When your ad beats it, you earn [X]% of the difference on every lead. For example, if the target is $20 and your ad delivers leads at $15, you earn [X]% of the $5 saved per lead.

- All AI tool subscriptions provided once hired



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. Your top 3 video ads and your top 3 static ads

2. For each one, a short explanation of why you think it worked

3. A breakdown of your current AI workflow: the tools, the models, and how you use them



Applications without AI video samples will not be considered.



TEST TASK

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test task. You'll be given 3 example ads and asked to create:

- 3 iterations of the existing ads

- 3 big-swing new concepts



You'll do your own research and use your own AI tools and APIs. The task is paid, and you can use the payment to cover your generation costs.

title: Office Manager / Service Coordinator - ServiceTitan - US HVAC (Starlink required)
description:
READ THE WHOLE POST. Applications that skip the three requirements at the bottom are

WHO WE ARE

Raber HVAC - heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical in Cleveland, Ohio. Real company,

real technicians in the field every day, growing fast. Everything runs on ServiceTitan.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for ONE person to run our office - and we are looking for someone who has

already done this at a BIGGER company than ours.



We do not want someone we have to train. We want the opposite. We want someone who walks

in and tells the owner how a real shop runs the board, because she has already done it at

a company with 15, 30, 50 technicians. If you have run dispatch at a serious US home

services company and you know ServiceTitan better than we do, this job is for you and the

pay will reflect it.



You will be the person the owner calls when he has a question - and you will have the

answer. That is the job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the ServiceTitan dispatch board. Assign and move technicians, build the day,

  handle same-day and emergency calls, keep the board tight and capacity full.

- Follow up on unsold estimates until they close. This is real money and you share in it.

- Sell and renew memberships.

- Handle the calls that need a human. We are putting an AI receptionist on the phones in

  the next month, but customers will still ask for a person, and that person is you.

- Outbound: recall lists, aging estimates, past customers.

- Keep jobs, notes, customer records and scheduling clean in ServiceTitan.

- Coordinate with the technicians all day, by phone and by text.

- Tell us what we are doing wrong. We expect you to improve how this office runs.



HOURS - READ THIS CAREFULLY

Monday to Friday, US Eastern time, Cleveland business hours. You must be genuinely AWAKE,

sharp and available during those hours - not someone who just rolled out of bed to answer

the phone. If your local time zone makes this a night shift for you, be honest with

yourself before you apply. We have been burned by this exact problem and we will screen

for it hard.



WHAT WE PAY

Base salary plus UNCAPPED monthly commission on collected labor - revived old estimates,

jobs you booked, memberships you sell. The better this company does, the more you make.

For someone who genuinely has the senior experience described above, the base is

negotiable and above the normal range for this platform. Tell us your number and back it

up with your history.



DO NOT APPLY IF

- You have never used ServiceTitan.

- Your experience is answering phones from a script and you have never owned a board.

- You need to be trained on US home services.

- You cannot work US Eastern business hours fully alert, every day.

- You have another job at the same time. This seat is exclusive and we verify it.

- You do not have STARLINK internet (or are not willing to get it before you start).



THREE REQUIREMENTS - APPLICATIONS WITHOUT ALL THREE ARE DELETED

1. EXPERIENCE, NAMED AND SPECIFIC. Name the US home services company you did this for,

   your dates, how many technicians were on the board you ran, and what your role was

   called. "Customer service for a US client" is not an answer. If we cannot verify it,

   it does not count.



2. TEACH US SOMETHING. In your own words, tell us TWO things a small HVAC company in

   Cleveland is probably doing wrong in ServiceTitan, and how you would fix them. Be

   specific and technical. This is the most important part of your application and it is

   how we tell a real operator from a resume.



3. A VOICE RECORDING. 60-90 seconds, one take, unscripted, recorded in your normal

   speaking voice. Use 
 and paste the link. Answer this:

   "A homeowner calls at 7:00 AM. Her furnace is dead, it is 20 degrees outside, she has

   a baby in the house and she is upset. Our first open slot is Thursday. What do you say

   to her, word for word, and what do you do in ServiceTitan?"

   Do not read from a script. We can hear it.



ALSO TELL US

- STARLINK INTERNET IS REQUIRED. Send a screenshot of your Starlink speed test (or tell us

  the date you will have it installed), plus your backup when it goes down.

- What you do when the power dies during your shift.

- Your monthly number in USD, and whether you are currently working anywhere else.



If you are the person we described, you already know it. Apply properly and you will hear

back from us fast.

Experience designing landing page sections or
 graphics

Paid through Deel on the first of each month

Employee or contractor, whichever you prefer. We hire directly.

13th-month pay, paid Philippine holidays, and 7 days of flexible leave

A Claude subscription and AI-first workflows

Direct daily feedback from the people spending the money, so you learn what actually wins instead of guessing

Start around 1 November

TO APPLY



Apply here, and only here:







Please do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not send a message, a resume, or a portfolio link through this platform. We do not read them. They are not sorted later and not reviewed in a batch. Create regression tests for previously discovered issues.

Test edge cases involving malformed, incomplete, or unusual customer data.

Review acceptance criteria together with developers before implementation.

Help improve our overall testing strategy and release process.

Investigate production issues and verify fixes.

Gradually automate repetitive manual QA work.



Our stack



You will primarily work with:



Python

title: Senior Paid Media & Performance Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS)
description:
High Point International Inc. helps B2B SaaS executives build high-conviction growth engines. We are looking for an analytical, hands-on growth strategist to bridge the gap between ad spend and bottom-line revenue.



Mission



Drive scalable pipeline growth for B2B SaaS clients by executing full-funnel paid media campaigns and establishing closed-loop CRM attribution. You will solve tracking blind spots, optimize multi-channel performance, and deliver clear, data-backed acquisition strategies that translate marketing investments into qualified demos, pipeline, and predictable revenue.



What You'll Do



- Build, manage, and optimize multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns across Google Search, Demand Gen, LinkedIn, Meta, and emerging platforms like OpenAI Ads, Reddit, and CTV.



- Establish end-to-end tracking and attribution integrity using Google Tag Manager, GA4, UTM frameworks, and CRM integrations (HubSpot/Salesforce) to connect ad interactions directly to pipeline and revenue.



- Conduct continuous channel experimentation, evaluating new platforms for audience fit, cost efficiency, creative requirements, and measurement capabilities.

- Translate complex performance data into clear narrative reporting for executive stakeholders, highlighting CAC, opportunity creation, ROI, and strategic next steps.



- Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, content, and web teams to design high-converting ad assets and landing page experiences tailored to ICP decision-makers.



What Success Looks Like



- High-trust tracking environments established across clients, ensuring 100% data alignment between ad platforms, analytics tools, and CRM pipeline reports.



- Shift in focus from vanity metrics (clicks/leads) to full-funnel efficiency, resulting in reduced CAC and higher demo-to-opportunity conversion rates.



- Clear experimental roadmap active at all times, leading to early adoption of profitable new acquisition channels.



- Executive-ready reporting delivered regularly, providing clear recommendations on where to scale, optimize, or reallocate ad spend.



Nice to Have



- Hands-on experience with emerging ad platforms like OpenAI Ads, Reddit, or CTV.
