title: Creative Strategist
description:
# Direct Response Creative Strategist



We are looking for a **Direct Response Creative Strategist** to join our team and help us consistently develop new winning ads for a fast-growing DTC brand.



This is not a social media content role.



We are not looking for someone whose job is to make content look pretty, follow trends, or come up with random creative ideas.



Your job is to understand:



**Why people buy. Why ads work. Why ads fail. And what we should test next.**



You will work closely with our media buying and creative teams to research the market, identify opportunities, develop new angles and concepts, and turn those ideas into clear briefs that our production team can execute.



## What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



* Researching customers, competitors, reviews, Reddit, forums, comments, and other sources to understand what our market actually thinks and says

* Identifying customer pain points, desires, objections, beliefs, fears, frustrations, and buying motivations

* Developing new marketing angles and creative concepts

* Creating concepts for both **video ads and static ads**

* Writing hooks, headlines, opening concepts, and messaging directions

* Building clear creative briefs for editors, designers, creators, and other members of the production team

* Reviewing existing winning ads and understanding **why they worked**

* Reviewing losing ads and identifying what we can learn from them

* Looking at performance data to determine what creative directions we should iterate on

* Creating variations of winning concepts without simply making meaningless duplicates

* Studying competitors and finding concepts, formats, hooks, mechanisms, and ideas we can adapt to our market

* Identifying new customer avatars and market segments we can target

* Developing new awareness-level and sophistication-level approaches

* Working with our team to continuously increase creative testing volume

* Maintaining organized documentation of learnings so we don't repeatedly test the same ideas without learning from them



## What We Care About



We care about **performance**.



A creative isn't good because it looks nice.



It's good if it gets attention, communicates the right message, creates desire, and ultimately gets people to buy.



You should naturally think about things like:



* Hooks

* Angles

* Avatars

* Awareness levels

* Customer sophistication

* Problems

* Desires

* Objections

* Beliefs

* Mechanisms

* Offers

* Proof

* Curiosity

* Emotional triggers

* Pattern interruption

* Ad fatigue

* Iteration

* Conversion



You should always be asking:



**What are we learning from the ads, and what should we test next?**



## Speed Matters



We move extremely fast.



We don't want someone spending an entire day trying to come up with one creative concept.



We test a lot of creatives, learn from the data, and move quickly.



You need to be comfortable producing **a high volume of ideas and briefs** while still thinking deeply about the psychology behind them.



Not every idea will work.



That's completely fine.



The goal is to create intelligent hypotheses, test them quickly, learn from the results, and use those learnings to make the next batch better.



## What We're Looking For



Ideally, you have experience with:



* Direct response marketing

* DTC/eCommerce brands

* Meta/Facebook advertising

* Performance creative

* Creative strategy

* Copywriting

* Customer research

* Competitor research

* Video ad concepts

* Static ad concepts

* Advertorials, VSLs, UGC, listicles, or other direct-response formats



You should have a strong understanding of **consumer psychology and copywriting**.



You do NOT need to personally edit videos or design ads.



We have people responsible for production.



Your responsibility is primarily the **thinking behind the creative** and communicating that thinking clearly enough that our production team can execute it.



## You Would Be a Great Fit If



You:



* Are obsessed with figuring out why people buy

* Can look at an ad and break down why it works

* Can turn customer research into actual creative concepts

* Understand that an angle and a hook are not the same thing

* Can produce a lot of ideas without producing generic garbage

* Are extremely curious

* Learn quickly

* Take feedback well

* Are comfortable having your ideas tested objectively by the market

* Don't get emotionally attached to your own concepts

* Can work independently

* Are extremely organized

* Move fast

* Want to become exceptionally good at direct-response marketing



## How We Work



We are a lean team and move quickly.



We would rather have a smaller number of extremely capable people than build a huge team of average performers.



There is a lot of opportunity for someone who performs well.



As you prove yourself, you can take ownership of more creative strategy, larger campaigns, new products, new markets, and eventually broader parts of the creative department.



We're building aggressively and want people who want to grow with us.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell us briefly about your experience with direct-response creative strategy.



2. What DTC/eCommerce brands or products have you worked on?



3. What advertising platforms have you created strategy for?



4. Send us **3–5 examples of ads or creative concepts you've worked on** and explain specifically what your contribution was.



5. Pick one of those ads and explain:



   * What the angle was

   * Who the avatar was

   * What awareness level you were targeting

   * Why you believed the concept would work

   * How it performed



6. When an ad becomes a winner, how do you d
 what variations to test next?



7. If an ad spends significant money but performs poorly, how would you analyze why it failed?



8. How do you research a completely new market before creating ads for it?



9. What's the difference between a **hook, angle, concept, and avatar**?



10. Approximately how many well-researched creative concepts/briefs could you realistically produce in a normal working day?



11. What tools do you currently use for creative research and competitor research?



12. What is your current availability?



Please start your application with the words **CREATIVE STRATEGIST** so we know you've read the entire post.



We're looking for someone long-term who wants to become extremely good at performance creative and grow with the company.

title: VIDEO EDITOR - LONG FORM +SHORT FORM CONTENT
description:
I’m looking for a talented video editor to help me create polished long-form and short-form content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Shorts.



This role is focused on editing.



I’m documenting a major life transition — losing a nearly $200K/year job in Los Angeles and figuring out what comes next. The content will include career, lifestyle, budgeting, fitness, personal moments, interviews, business ideas, and day-to-day life.



I need an editor who can take raw footage and turn it into content that is clean, engaging, polished, and enjoyable to watch.



### What You’ll Be Doing



* Editing long-form YouTube videos

* Editing TikToks, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Cleaning up raw footage and assembling strong edits

* Cutting for pacing, clarity, and viewer retention

* Removing dead space, repetition, and anything unnecessary

* Adding captions, music, sound effects, graphics, zooms, and B-roll where appropriate

* Making videos feel polished without feeling over-edited or fake

* Delivering content in the correct formats for different platforms

* Making revisions based on feedback



### What I’m Looking For



I want someone who is strong in the actual craft of editing.



You should be good at:



* Pacing

* Clean cuts

* Music selection

* Sound design

* Captions

* Graphics

* Visual timing

* Long-form editing

* Short-form editing

* Organizing footage and project files

* Following direction while still bringing a good editing eye



You do NOT need to be the content strategist or producer for this role.



I mainly need someone who can take direction, work with footage efficiently, and create strong final edits.



Experience editing creator content, YouTube videos, Reels, TikToks, vlogs, documentary-style content, or personality-driven content is a big plus.



### Ideal Editor



My ideal editor is someone who:



* Has a strong eye for detail

* Understands how to keep videos moving

* Knows how to make content feel clean and modern

* Can edit both horizontal and vertical formats

* Communicates well

* Meets deadlines

* Is open to feedback and revisions

* Can work with me consistently over time



### Long-Term Opportunity



This is not just for one video.



I’m looking for someone I can work with consistently as more content is filmed.



The ideal person can grow with the project and become a reliable long-term editor.



### How to Apply



Please send ONLY your 2–4 best editing samples.



I especially want to see:



* Long-form YouTube content

* TikToks / Reels / Shorts

* Creator or personality-driven content



Please also answer the following:



1. What editing software do you use?

2. How many hours per week are you available?

3. What is your hourly or monthly rate?

4. Have you edited both long-form and short-form content?

5. Have you worked with creator or personal brand content before?

6. How quickly can you usually turn around edits?

7. Are you comfortable doing revisions?



### Paid Test Edit



Final candidates may be given a paid test edit.



You’ll receive raw footage and may be asked to create:



* A short long-form sequence

* One short-form vertical clip



If you’re a strong editor who can make footage feel polished, engaging, and professional, I’d love to see your work.

Values accuracy, structure, and consistency

MarketMan



Square POS



Rota Ready



Excel / Google Sheets

Experience working as a Virtual Assistant

Professional written English

Desirable (Not Essential)

Experience supporting management accounts

Success in this role will be measured by:

Clean, audit-ready financial records



Reliability of cashflow and P&L reporting



Accuracy of sales and cost data across systems

Consistency, ownership, and follow-through



This is a delivery-focused finance role, not a passive admin or task-only VA position.



Who This Role Is NOT For



People who dislike reconciliations or financial detail



People who struggle with accuracy, consistency, or deadlines



People looking for short-term, freelance, or “side hustle” work

title: Platform Implementation & Quality Specialist (Shopify / Web QA)
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Platform Implementation & Quality Specialist to help us ensure top-tier quality and accuracy for our merchant-facing web experiences. 



In this role, your primary focus will be reviewing and validating completed site implementations, experience builds, bug fixes, and development work prior to release. You will work directly with our internal Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to track down and resolve issues. Additionally, you will support select web experience builds and platform configurations as needed. 



Key Responsibilities

• Review and validate implementations, web builds, bug fixes, and dev tickets to ensure they meet specifications. 



• Perform functional, visual, responsive (desktop/mobile), regression, and edge-case testing. 



• Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and supporting screenshots/recordings. 



• Collaborate directly with the Development Team to resolve issues and re-verify fixes before release. 



• Implement minor merchant-requested changes and configure web platform experiences based on approved requirements. 



• Maintain clear documentation and seamless communication across our dev and support teams. 



Requirements

• Experience: 1+ years in web Quality Assurance (QA), platform configuration, web implementation, or website content management. 



• Ticketing Systems: Proven experience using tools like HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira, or similar. 



• Core Technical Skills: Proficiency in HTML and CSS. 



• QA & Testing Expertise: Strong functional, visual, responsive, and edge-case testing skills with high attention to detail. 



• Communication: Excellent written and verbal English skills. Must be able to document findings clearly and communicate effectively. 



Nice-to-Haves / Advantages:

• Hands-on experience with Shopify or e-commerce, CMS, and personalization platforms. 



• Familiarity with JavaScript and browser Developer Tools (Chrome DevTools). 



• Experience or familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) platforms. 





How to Apply:



To apply, please reply with:



• A working link to your updated resume.



• A cover letter detailing your hands-on experience with QA and HTML/CSS.



• Use QA as the subject title of your application message.



Note: We will only review candidates who strictly follow the application instructions above.

title: CALL CENTER MANAGER / DIALING TEAM LEAD
description:
IF YOU DO NOT FOLLOW DIRECTIONS YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IMMEDIATELY DISQUALIFIED!!!



ABOUT OHC PHARMACY

Optimistic Healthcare Solutions (OHC Pharmacy) is a licensed pharmacy and DME (Durable Medical Equipment) provider based in Houston, TX. We serve Medicare and Medicaid patients, helping them access equipment they need — knee and back braces, CGMs, nebulizers, TENS units, lymphedema equipment, and more.

Our call center is the engine of our operation. Dialing agents qualify inbound leads, collect insurance information, and move patients through our GoHighLevel pipeline every day. We are fast-paced, systems-driven, and growing.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a Call Center Manager to own the performance of our dialing agent team. This is not a basic VA role. You are the quality controller, coach, trainer, and hiring manager rolled into one. You report directly to the owner and you are the first person held accountable for team results.

If you have never listened to recorded calls and scored agents, trained someone from zero, or managed a team's daily KPIs — this role is not for you. If you have done all of those things and want real ownership over a growing healthcare call center, keep reading.



OUR FOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Call Quality Assurance (QA)



Listen to recorded calls in GoHighLevel regularly — daily or weekly depending on agent tenure

Score each call: greeting, script adherence, qualification accuracy, note-taking, stage movement, professionalism

Flag calls with compliance issues, wrong information given, or missed qualification steps

Deliver written feedback to each agent after every QA review

Report QA scores to the owner weekly



2. Agent Training and Coaching



Onboard new agents using our existing SOPs, scripts, and GoHighLevel training materials

Run role-play sessions before agents go live

Coach agents on tone, script delivery, objection handling, and note-taking standards

Identify skill gaps from QA reviews and address them with targeted coaching

Update training materials when scripts or processes change



3. Hiring and Performance Management



Post job listings on OnlineJobs.ph when new agents are needed

Screen applicants, conduct interviews, and make hiring recommendations to the owner

Run paid trial shifts to evaluate candidates before offering a position

Document performance issues clearly and follow a warning process before termination

Make recommendations on who to keep, who to coach up, and who to let go



4. Daily Metrics and Reporting



Track daily KPIs for each agent: calls made, contacts, qualifications, pipeline stages moved, notes logged

Review 
 boards each morning to verify all agents logged their activity

Verify GoHighLevel pipeline stages are accurate and catch anything sitting in the wrong stage

Send a brief daily summary to the owner covering who is performing, who is not, and any issues

Flag unusual lead flow, system problems, or agent absences immediately





TOOLS YOU WILL USE



GoHighLevel (GHL) — Primary CRM and dialer. Agents call from here. You review call recordings, audit pipeline stages, and monitor lead flow.


 — Agent KPI tracking and daily activity logs. You review boards and hold agents accountable.

Slack / WhatsApp — Team communication. Daily check-ins and issue escalations.

Hubstaff — Time tracking. You review clock-in and productivity data.

Google Sheets — Scorecards, reporting, and agent performance tracking.



WHAT YOUR AGENTS DO

You need to understand the agent workflow cold so you can catch when something is wrong.



Log into GoHighLevel. Review the Opportunity Board. Check new lead count for the day.

Open the GoHighLevel Dialer. Press Start. Work assigned leads.

Follow the 3-day / 7-touch cadence: Day 1 — 3 calls + 2 texts. Day 2 — 2 calls + 1 text. Day 3 — 2 calls + 1 text.

Primary goal on first contact: qualify the patient and collect insurance information for an eligibility check.

Log notes in GoHighLevel after EVERY interaction without exception.

Move each lead to the correct pipeline stage immediately after every call or text.

Report daily KPIs in 
 before end of shift.



Products agents qualify patients for: back braces, knee braces, shoulder braces, wrist braces, CGMs, nebulizers, TENS units, lymphedema equipment, lift chairs.



REQUIREMENTS



Minimum 2 years managing an outbound call center, sales floor, or dialing team as a supervisor or team lead

You have personally listened to recorded calls, scored agents, and delivered written feedback — this is non-negotiable

You have trained agents on scripts, tone, and compliance from day one and have an onboarding process

You have interviewed, hired, and terminated employees and know how to document performance issues

You have tracked daily call metrics and reported performance to leadership regularly

Strong written and spoken English — you communicate with agents and the owner in English daily

Monday through Friday availability with overlap during US Central Time business hours





NICE TO HAVE



Experience in healthcare, DME, pharmacy, or insurance-related call centers

Prior use of GoHighLevel, 
, or similar CRM and dialer platforms

Experience managing VA teams on OnlineJobs.ph

Familiarity with HIPAA call center compliance basics





HOW TO APPLY

Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile link

A 2 to 3 minute voice recording answering this question: Describe how you have managed a dialing team and what your QA process looked like

The names of any CRM or dialer platforms you have used

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Digital Marketing Pro - PPC / Google Ads, Website Build & SEO (US Home Services Co., Full-Time)
description:
We are a growing HVAC, Plumbing and Electrical company in Cleveland, Ohio (USA), and we are launching a new electrical brand. We are looking for ONE excellent full-time digital marketing professional to own our entire online presence.



This is not an entry-level "social media assistant" job. You are the person responsible for how many phone calls our business gets. We want a pro.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. PPC - THIS IS THE #1 PRIORITY

- Build, launch, run and optimize all of our paid advertising: Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Local Services Ads / Google Guaranteed), Bing Ads and paid social.

- Own the budget, bidding, keywords, negative keywords, ad copy, landing pages and call tracking.

- We measure you on BOOKED JOBS and cost per booked job - not impressions and not clicks.



2. BUILD OUR WEBSITE

- Build the website for our electrical company from scratch (WordPress or a modern equivalent).

- Fast, mobile-first and built to convert: click-to-call, service pages, service-area pages, quote forms, reviews, and tracking installed correctly.

- Keep it maintained and keep improving it.



3. SEO

- Local SEO for the Cleveland / Northeast Ohio market: Google Business Profile optimization, service-area pages, on-page and technical SEO, citations and review generation.

- Get us ranking in the local map pack.



4. TRACKING AND REPORTING

- GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking and call tracking (CallRail or similar).

- Weekly report: spend, leads, booked jobs, cost per lead, what you changed, what is next. You must be able to prove what every dollar produced.



5. CREATIVE AND SOCIAL

- Produce social media graphics, ad creative and simple video edits.

- Manage and post consistently on our social channels.



WHAT WE REQUIRE

- PROVEN PPC experience. You must be able to show real Google Ads accounts you personally managed, the budgets, and the results. This is our #1 requirement.

- You can build a professional website yourself, end to end - not just "edit a template".

- Strong local SEO experience, ideally for US home-service businesses.

- Hands-on with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion / call tracking.

- Good written English - you will write ad copy and website copy aimed at American homeowners.

- Design ability: Canva, Photoshop or Figma.

- Extremely organized, self-managing and proactive. We want a professional who tells US what should be done next, not someone waiting for instructions.



BIG PLUS

- Experience marketing HVAC, plumbing or electrical companies in the United States.

- Experience with Local Services Ads (Google Guaranteed).

- Google Ads certification.

- Experience with ServiceTitan (we run our whole operation on it) or similar field-service software.



THE SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with a solid daily overlap with US Eastern Time business hours so you can coordinate with the owner and the office.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term, stable full-time position with a growing US company.

- Real ownership of the marketing - your work directly grows the business, and your pay grows with it.

- Direct access to the owner. No layers of management.



THE WEBSITE WE WANT - LOOK AT THIS FIRST

Here is the standard we are aiming at: 

Study it before you apply. Notice that it is not a brochure, it is a lead machine: click-to-call and "book online" on every screen and in a sticky mobile bar, proof and star ratings directly under the hero, a booking form high on the page, a separate page for every single service, a separate page for every city we serve, standing coupon offers, and an FAQ section. That is the machine we want you to build for us - our own brand, our own photos, our own copy.



In your application, tell us ONE thing you would do better than that site.



HOW TO APPLY - READ THIS CAREFULLY

Applications that do not follow these steps will not be read.



1. Start your message with the word PPC.

2. Send links to 2 or 3 websites that YOU personally built.

3. Tell us the monthly ad budget you have personally managed, on which platforms, and the actual results (leads, cost per lead, conversion rate).

4. Tell us which of the four areas above is your strongest and which is your weakest. Be honest.

5. Answer the question above: one thing you would do better than the reference site.

6. Include your WhatsApp number. Shortlisted candidates get a live WhatsApp video interview with the owner.

title: Office Manager / Dispatcher / Inside Sales - ServiceTitan - US HVAC (Cleveland, Ohio)
description:
OFFICE MANAGER / DISPATCHER / INSIDE SALES - ServiceTitan - US HVAC Company (Cleveland, Ohio)



READ THIS WHOLE POST BEFORE APPLYING. Applications that skip the three requirements at the

bottom are deleted without a reply. We are not being rude - we have hired before and we are

done wasting time.



WHO WE ARE

Raber HVAC - heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical in Cleveland, Ohio. Real company,

real technicians in the field every day, growing fast. We run everything on ServiceTitan.



WHO WE WANT

One person to run our office. You are the voice of this company on the phone. When a customer

in Cleveland has no heat at 7am, you are who they talk to. You d
 which technician goes

where, you keep the board full, and you turn phone calls into booked jobs.



This is not a "virtual assistant" job and it is not a data-entry job. This is the person who

holds the office together and pushes revenue up. If you do that well, you will be paid like

someone who does that well - there is a monthly commission on top of your base, uncapped.

The better this company does, the more you make. We want somebody who wants that.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer every inbound call and convert it into a booked job. We measure your BOOKING RATE.

- Run the ServiceTitan dispatch board: assign and move technicians, optimize the day, handle

 same-day and emergency calls, keep the board tight.

- Follow up on unsold estimates until they close. This is real money and it is your money too.

- Sell and renew memberships.

- Outbound calls: recall lists, aging estimates, past customers.

- Keep job notes, customer records and scheduling clean in ServiceTitan.

- Coordinate with the technicians all day - by phone and by text.



HOURS

Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Cleveland time (US Eastern). 60 hours a week.

That is 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time. This is a NIGHT SHIFT for you. Be honest with

yourself before you apply - we need you sharp at 3am your time, every night, for years.



PAY

1,600 to 1,800 US dollars a month base, depending on what you actually bring, PLUS an

uncapped monthly commission on what the office produces. A strong person here clears

2,500 to 3,000 a month. There is no ceiling on the commission - that is the whole point.

Tell us the monthly number you need. Serious, experienced people are paid seriously here.



=====================================================================

THE THREE REQUIREMENTS - NO EXCEPTIONS

=====================================================================



1. ENGLISH - SPOKEN, FAST, CLEAR, NEUTRAL ACCENT

 You will be on the phone with American homeowners all day. They must never have to ask you

 to repeat yourself. If you have worked US voice accounts in a call center and Americans

 understood you easily, that is what we are looking for.



 *** SEND A VOICE RECORDING WITH YOUR APPLICATION. 60 TO 90 SECONDS. ***

 Do not send a script you read out loud. Answer this, out loud, as if it were a real call:



 "A homeowner calls at 7:00 AM. Her furnace is dead, it is 20 degrees outside, she has a

 baby in the house and she is upset. Our first open slot is Thursday. What do you say to

 her, word for word, and what do you do in ServiceTitan?"



 No recording = no reply. This is the first thing we listen to.



2. EXPERIENCE - WE DO NOT TRAIN

 You must already know ServiceTitan and you must already know US home services

 (HVAC / plumbing / electrical). Day one you run the board on your own.

 In your application, name the US company you did this for and for how long, and say exactly

 what you did in ServiceTitan: dispatch board, scheduling, invoicing, unsold estimates,

 memberships, pricebook. "I am a fast learner" is not an answer to this.



3. INTERNET AND POWER - PROVE IT

 Our last hire went dark mid-shift because his line was cut and he had no backup. Never again.

 Send us:

 - a speedtest.net screenshot from where you will actually work

 - proof of a BACKUP INTERNET connection (mobile hotspot / second provider)

 - proof of BACKUP POWER (UPS or battery that keeps your router and computer alive)

 - one sentence: what do you do the moment the power dies at 2am in the middle of a shift?



 We do not accept excuses about internet or power. Ever. If that sounds harsh, this job is

 not for you.



=====================================================================



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with: (1) your voice recording, (2) your ServiceTitan / US home-services history with

company names and dates, (3) your internet and power proof, (4) the monthly number you need

and for how many hours a week, (5) your WhatsApp number.



Anything missing and we move on to the next person. Everything included and you will hear

from us within 24 hours.

title: Cybersecurity Content & GTM Marketing Specialist
description:
SecureForge Advisory is looking for a highly resourceful marketer to support cybersecurity companies with content creation, market research, GTM messaging, LinkedIn, and targeted demand generation.



This is primarily a behind-the-scenes role. You will research cybersecurity and technology topics, develop content ideas, create polished graphics and written content, and package everything for review before publication. As you become familiar with our clients and messaging, the role may expand into directly managing posting, social engagement, and targeted outreach.



You do not need to already be a cybersecurity expert, but you must be capable of learning technical concepts quickly and turning research into professional B2B marketing content.



Responsibilities include:

* Research cybersecurity, OT/ICS, critical infrastructure, IT, competitors, industry news, and market trends

*Develop LinkedIn content ideas based on that research

*Draft LinkedIn posts for companies and executives

*Create professional graphics, diagrams, carousels, and other social content

*Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to accelerate research, writing, ideation, and content production

*Use Canva or similar tools to create polished visual assets

*Build weekly and monthly content calendars

*Repurpose one technical topic into multiple pieces of content

*Research target companies and prospective customers

*Build targeted prospect/contact lists based on defined customer profiles

*Draft personalized LinkedIn outreach and follow-up messaging

*Identify potential prospects engaging with our content

*Support demand-generation campaigns around events, products, industries, and specific target accounts

*Track content performance and recommend topics that are generating engagement



Initially, most content and outreach will be submitted for review before being published or sent.



We are looking for someone who:

*Has excellent written English

*Understands B2B LinkedIn marketing

*Has strong visual/design instincts

*Uses AI tools extensively and effectively

*Can research unfamiliar technical subjects independently

*Can turn complex information into clear, engaging content

*Avoids generic or obviously AI-generated writing

*Is organized and able to manage multiple clients/content calendars

*Takes feedback well and improves quickly

*Can work independently without being given step-by-step instructions

*Cybersecurity or B2B technology experience is a major plus, but strong research ability and willingness to learn are more important.



To apply, please include:

* Examples of LinkedIn or B2B content you have created

* Examples of graphics, carousels, or marketing assets you have designed

* Which AI tools you currently use and how you use them

* Any experience with LinkedIn outreach, lead generation, or prospect research



In 3-5 sentences, explain how you would turn one cybersecurity topic into a week of LinkedIn content

Shortlisted candidates will complete a small practical exercise.

title: AI Video Editor - Long-term Remote Position (Meta Ads, Spanish Market)
description:
WHO WE ARE

 

We are a growing wellness brand selling in Spain and Mexico. Our main channel is Meta Ads, and we are scaling fast. We are looking for a video editor who wants to grow with us long-term, not a one-off freelancer.

 

If you love creating AI-driven video ads that convert, you will fit here.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 

This is not a short project. We want someone who can become a core part of our production team.

 

You will work on:

 

- AI avatar videos (HeyGen) - our main format

- AI-generated animations (Kling, Higgsfield, Nano Banana)

- Short-form ads for
 and Instagram

- Longer VSL-style videos when needed

- Winning ad variations (hooks, banners, CTAs)

 

We produce for two markets - Spain (Castilian Spanish) and Mexico (Mexican Spanish). No need to speak Spanish natively, but attention to detail with the text is essential.

 

WHAT MAKES A GOOD FIT

 

- You are FAST. A HeyGen avatar video takes you 3-4 hours, not 10.

- You care about the details. Spanish accents, punctuation, clean audio.

- You are HONEST. You tell us if a video will take longer BEFORE you start, not after.

- You are RELIABLE. Deadlines matter. Communication matters.

- You OWN your work. You catch mistakes before we do.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

- $5-6/hour USD starting rate

- Long-term stable work (not one-off gigs)

- All tools covered (HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Kling, CapCut Pro, Claude)

- Growth: your role and hours grow as we scale

- Clear rules from day one - no surprises, no games

 

IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ

 

- For the test project you use your own tool accounts. Free trials are fine.

- We monitor tool usage. Using our accounts for anything other than our work = immediate end of collaboration.

- We track hours and pay them, but hours must match real work. Inflated hours = immediate end of collaboration.

 

If those rules feel too strict, this is not for you. Please do not apply.

 

If you thrive with clear expectations, keep reading.

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send us:

 

1. Your portfolio link (must include AI avatar work in ad format)

2. Your hourly rate (must be within 5-6 USD)

3. A short 15-30 second video sample where YOU edited an AI avatar

 

Applications without these three items in the FIRST message will not be reviewed.

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

 

1. If your portfolio fits, we send you a paid test project

2. Short interview by Google Meet or text (your choice)

3. Long-term role after trial if it works for both sides

 

We are excited to find someone who wants to grow with us.

 

Apply now.

title: Video Editor + AI Creator for Meta Ads (HeyGen, CapCut, Spanish ES + MX)
description:
Hi! I'm looking for a part-time Video Editor who can also create AI-powered content (avatars, animations, AI visuals) for
 & Instagram ads in SPANISH - both Castilian Spanish (Spain) and Mexican Spanish.



IMPORTANT: All videos will be in Spanish. We produce for TWO markets:

- Spain -> Castilian Spanish (NOT Latin American)

- Mexico -> Mexican Spanish



You don't need to speak Spanish, but you must be comfortable working with Spanish scripts, subtitles, and voiceovers in both variants. Attention to detail with Spanish text is critical - we never mix the two markets and we never deliver work with typos or wrong accents.



This is NOT a generic video editing job. I need someone who understands that ads on Meta need to LOOK like real content, not like an ad. If you only know how to edit corporate or YouTube-style videos, this is not for you.



------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL DO

------------------------------



- Edit short-form video ads (15-60 seconds) AND long-form videos (1-5 minutes) for
 & Instagram

- Produce videos for BOTH markets (Spain + Mexico), with different scripts, avatars, and voiceovers for each

- Create AI avatar videos using HeyGen (Soul ID / Character mode)

- Generate AI images using Nano Banana Pro / Midjourney / similar tools

- Add Spanish captions, subtitles, hooks, b-roll, sound design

- Edit raw UGC footage into native-style ads (handheld, "authentic" look)

- Create AI animations - both simple AND advanced (motion graphics, product reveals, transitions, complex AI-generated sequences)

- Adapt winning ads into multiple variations (different hooks, different angles)

- Manage and organize raw footage and final assets in Google Drive



------------------------------

TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW (REQUIRED)

------------------------------



* CapCut (Pro) - daily driver

* Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve

* HeyGen (avatar generation, Soul ID Character mode)

* Higgsfield (for high-quality AI video generation)

* ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools

* Any AI image generator (Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux, etc.)



------------------------------

NICE TO HAVE (BONUS POINTS)

------------------------------



* Runway / Kling / Sora (AI video generation)

* After Effects (motion graphics)

* Experience editing for DTC / e-commerce brands

* Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices

* Basic Spanish reading comprehension (helps a lot - most scripts will be in Spanish)



------------------------------

WHO YOU ARE

------------------------------



- FAST AND DETAIL-ORIENTED. A HeyGen avatar video should take 2-4 hours, not 10. You work efficiently AND check your work before delivering.

- ZERO TYPOS, ZERO MISSING ACCENTS. You triple-check Spanish text before delivering. Errors get caught BY YOU, not by me.

- RELIABLE WITH DEADLINES. If you say it'll be done Tuesday, it's done Tuesday.

- You understand "native" content - ads that don't look like ads.

- You take direction well but also bring ideas.

- You have stable internet and a computer that can handle 4K editing.

- You're available to communicate during agreed working hours.



------------------------------

WHO YOU ARE NOT

------------------------------



- Someone who needs hand-holding on every task.

- Someone who delivers slow and sloppy work.

- Someone who copies the same template for every ad.

- Someone who ghosts for 3 days without warning.

- A "video editor" who has never touched an AI tool.



------------------------------

TOOLS - IMPORTANT

------------------------------



Once hired, I provide ALL the tools and AI credits you need (HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, etc.). You won't pay anything from your side.



For the TEST PROJECT, I can't cover tools because I receive many applications and it's not sustainable to provide tools to every candidate. You'd need to use trials or your own subscriptions just for the test. Most platforms have free tiers that work fine for this.



------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

------------------------------



Send me:

 - Your portfolio (links to videos you edited - Drive, YouTube, Vimeo, etc.)

 - At least ONE example of an AI avatar video you created (HeyGen or similar)

 - Your part-time hourly rate in USD



IMPORTANT: Applications missing portfolio or hourly rate will be ignored.



------------------------------

NEXT STEPS - FAIR TEST POLICY

------------------------------



Shortlisted candidates will complete a small test project (1 short video ad + 1 short AI animation).



- If the test meets the quality standard, you GET PAID for it at your full hourly rate, and we move forward to a long-term arrangement.

- If the test does not meet the quality standard, the test is unpaid, and we part ways with no hard feelings.



If we click, this is a long-term, stable part-time role with growing scope. I prefer to build long relationships, not rotate freelancers.



Looking forward to seeing your work!

title: Creator Sourcing & Management

title: Content Creator (Paid Ads)
description:
GO HERE: tiny 
 / IZCONTENT

(only applications sent here will be processed)



What You'll Do

On-Camera Content Creation

Record short-form video advertisements and UGC-style content on a consistent basis.

Deliver scripts naturally and conversationally rather than simply reading from a script.

Record multiple variations of the same concept using different hooks, openings, tones, or calls to action.

Create different video formats, including:

Talking-head videos

Walk-and-talk videos

Problem/solution videos

Educational/explainer videos

Testimonial-style content

Product/service demonstrations

Storytelling-style ads

Adapt your delivery based on the intended audience and creative direction.

Maintain a professional but relatable on-camera presence appropriate for U.S. healthcare and business audiences.

Creative Execution

Work from scripts, concepts, briefs, or talking points provided by the marketing team.

Suggest improvements to scripts when something sounds unnatural when spoken on camera.

Help develop different ways to present the same message or advertising concept.

Record multiple hooks and variations so the marketing team can test different versions.

Follow creative references and examples while still making the delivery feel authentic.

Incorporate feedback and quickly re-record or revise content when needed.

Video Production

Record high-quality video and audio from your home setup.

Maintain appropriate lighting, framing, background, and sound quality.

Perform basic short-form video editing when required.

Add captions, cuts, B-roll, screen recordings, or other simple visual elements when appropriate.

Organize and submit raw footage and finished content according to the team's workflow.

What We're Looking For

Required

Strong English communication skills.

Confident, natural, and engaging presence on camera.

Comfortable recording yourself frequently as part of your regular work.

Experience creating UGC, TikTok, Reels, short-form videos, advertisements, or similar video content.

Ability to make scripted content sound conversational and authentic.

Good understanding of pacing, hooks, storytelling, and keeping viewers engaged.

Basic understanding of short-form video editing.

Ability to receive feedback and quickly produce new versions or re-record content.

Reliable internet connection and an appropriate environment for recording professional-quality videos.

Preferred



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



UGC advertisements

Paid social media ads

Meta/Facebook advertising content

TikTok or Instagram Reels

CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

Direct-response advertising

U.S.-based audiences

Healthcare

Staffing, recruitment, or virtual assistant services

B2B or professional services



You do not need to be a media buyer or paid ads specialist. Your primary responsibility will be creating and performing the content used in our advertisements.



What Success Looks Like



You are successful in this role when you can consistently turn our creative ideas and scripts into high-quality, natural, engaging videos that are ready for advertising.



We are looking for someone who:



Can produce new video content consistently.

Looks and sounds comfortable on camera.

Can deliver the same script in several different ways without making each version feel identical.

Understands how important the first few seconds of a short-form video are.

Takes direction well without needing every movement or line explained.

Can quickly re-record content based on feedback.

Continually improves their delivery based on which styles and videos perform best.

Ideal Candidate



You might be a great fit if you are already a:



UGC Creator

Content Creator

TikTok/Reels Creator

On-Camera Social Media Talent

Video Content Creator

Social Media Content Specialist



You don't necessarily need years of corporate marketing experience.



We care more about whether you can communicate naturally on camera, create engaging content, follow creative direction, and consistently produce strong videos.

title: Inbound & Outbound Phone Support Representative
description:
We are seeking an articulate and confident Phone Support Representative to manage inbound customer service calls and conduct proactive outbound follow-ups for UK clients. You will serve as the primary voice of the business, providing empathetic, friendly, and efficient resolution to customer inquiries, complaints, and service requests.



This is a voice-based customer service role ideal for a professional with excellent spoken English and strong telephone etiquette.



What you'll be doing



Answering inbound customer calls using cloud telephony tools (Aircall, RingCentral, JustCall)

Conducting proactive outbound call follow-ups regarding unresolved tickets, deliveries, or account updates

Actively listening to customer issues, de-escalating tense situations, and providing clear telephone assistance

Documenting concise, accurate call summary notes and updating CRM/helpdesk records during and after calls

Transferring complex or tier-2 technical calls to senior departments with accurate context handoffs



Essential skills and experience



Outstanding spoken English with clear pronunciation, professional tone, and neutral accent

Proven telephone customer service experience handling high call volumes

Active listening skills paired with the ability to remain calm and composed under pressure

Proficiency in using VoIP softphone tools (Aircall, RingCentral, CloudTalk) and logging call notes accurately



Desirable (Nice to Have)



Previous experience supporting UK-based callers and understanding UK cultural norms

Experience combining phone calls with live ticketing systems for multi-channel support



What We Offer



Fully remote position with predictable working hours aligned to the UK time zone

Full administrative, payroll, and local HR support managed by Level Up Teams

Access to ongoing voice training and customer success upskilling

Competitive base pay and long-term career growth



SKILL REQUIREMENT



Phone Support, Inbound Calling, Outbound Calls, Customer Service, Conflict Resolution, VoIP, Verbal Communication



How to Apply



Please send your resume along with a short note on your recruitment sourcing experience and the platforms you've used. Let us know your availability (part-time or full-time) and preferred working hours.

title: Revit Families Modeler
description:
Company: RD Studio (rdstudio.co)

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance

Location: Remote (Targeting APAC / Southeast Asia)



RD Studio is an international BIM content company known for high-quality Revit families used by thousands of architects worldwide. We are expanding our team and looking for a Revit Family Modeler who specializes in complex, highly parametric content.



(Note: We are specifically looking for advanced modelers. If you are a beginner or only build basic geometry without nested parameters, this role is not for you).





? What You’ll Do

- Build complex parametric content: Create professional, lightweight Revit families from scratch using nested families, complex formulas, and advanced constraints.

- Maintain strict quality: Follow our internal BIM standards for geometry, parameters, materials, and visibility.

- Draft diverse assets: Work on furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, electrical, structural, and more.

- Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.



???? What We’re Looking For

- Advanced Parametric Experience: Proven ability to build highly flexible families (portfolio and .RFA samples are required).

- Technical Mastery: Deep understanding of shared parameters, reference planes, type catalogs, and mathematical/logical formulas.

- Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

- Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

- Bonus: Experience modeling MEP or Structural content.





???? Why Join Us?

100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

Skill Growth: Get consistent feedback from industry experts to elevate your BIM skills.

Career Progression: Long-term collaboration with the potential to grow into a Senior Modeler or QA Leadership role.





???? Location & Budget

This full-time freelance position is targeted toward candidates based in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Thailand, Myanmar, etc.), as our budget is benchmarked to competitive full-time freelance rates in these regions.





???? How to Apply

Send an email to 
 with the subject: Revit Family Modeler — [Your Name]





Please include:

1. A short introduction about your experience with complex parametric modeling.

2. Your portfolio (PDF or link).

3. At least 5 sample Revit families (.RFA format) demonstrating your highest level of parametric complexity.

4. Your current availability for full-time work.

title: Customer Support Specialist (Email, Multilingual, AI-Assisted) – 100% Remote
description:
Who are we?

We are an e-commerce brand selling supplements and wellness products, mainly in the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) and several other European markets. Most of our customers find us through Meta ads 
 and Instagram), and we ship directly to them from our fulfillment partner in China.



As we grow, we are building out our customer support team. You will report directly to management and help shape how our support works as we scale.



Who are we looking for?

Our customers write to us in German and French. You don't need to speak either language: we use Claude (AI) to translate incoming tickets and draft replies. What you need is excellent English, sharp judgment, and the attention to detail to make sure every reply is correct before it goes out.



We use Claude (AI) as part of our support workflow. It drafts replies, translates, and summarizes tickets. Your job is to make sure every message that leaves our inbox is accurate, on-brand and sounds human, and to keep improving how we use AI in support.



What you will do



Customer communication



Clear all daily tickets across all of our stores and languages, every day

Review, correct and personalize AI-drafted replies so they are accurate and never sound robotic

Answer questions about order status, tracking, product usage, address changes, cancellations and returns

Stay calm and professional with frustrated customers, and turn negative experiences into positive ones

Never give medical advice or make health claims about our products, and escalate sensitive cases to management



AI and knowledge base



Maintain and improve our Claude setup: prompts, FAQs, macros, product information and tone-of-voice guidelines

Spot where AI answers go wrong and fix the underlying knowledge, not just the single reply

Make sure translations sound natural to native speakers, not machine-translated



Shopify order management



Process full and partial refunds in Shopify

Create draft orders for replacements and reshipments

Give customers discounts within our guidelines

Update product availability and flag listing issues



Fulfillment, returns and disputes



Communicate with our fulfillment partner about tracking, stock, reshipments and damaged items

Log every refund, return and reshipment accurately in our tracking sheet

Handle PayPal disputes, Shopify Payments chargebacks and payment provider cases by submitting clear evidence



Analysis and improvement



Analyze refund and complaint data every month: top reasons, problem products, costs and trends

Identify products or processes that cause many complaints and bring them to management with a clear recommendation

Suggest improvements to our macros, product pages, FAQs, post-purchase
s and processes



What we require



1+ year of
 customer support experience in e-commerce, ideally Shopify dropshipping or DTC excellent written English. [Further languages, e.g. French, Italian or Dutch, are a big plus.]

Hands-on experience with the Shopify admin (refunds, draft orders, discounts)

Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work, and a critical eye for when their output is wrong

Comfortable with Google Sheets (filters, basic formulas, simple summaries)

Familiar with tracking tools like 17TRACK or ParcelPanel

Understanding of how cross-border e-commerce works, including longer shipping times and working with suppliers in China

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to follow SOPs consistently

Problem-solving mindset and willingness to take initiative

Stable internet connection, your own computer, and good availability throughout the day (CET)



Nice to have



Experience with supplements, wellness or beauty products, and awareness of what you can and can't say about them

Experience with PayPal disputes and chargebacks at scale

Experience building or improving AI support workflows, prompts or knowledge bases



What we can offer you



100% remote: work from anywhere

Flexible hours, as long as tickets are cleared daily within our response times

A long-term, stable position

Growth opportunities: we reward top performers, and strong team members can grow into a CS lead or operations role



What do we value?



Results first! If something needs to be done, we make it happen.

Open communication. If we have a problem, we talk. If we have an idea, we discuss it. If we learn something new, we document it.

The customer's experience is our reputation. Every reply matters, whether a human or AI wrote the first draft.



How to apply



Put #SUPPCS at the end of your cover letter, so we know you have read the full description.

Tell us about your e-commerce customer support experience: which platforms, helpdesk tools and languages you've worked with, how many tickets you handled per day, and how you've used AI tools in support.

title: Immediate Hiring! Experienced Bookeepers (Only Manila Based candidates)
description:
Experienced Bookkeeper



Remote Manila based  |  11:00am–7:00pm Philippine time  |  Monday to Friday



Love getting the details right? Join Solve Outsource Inc. and help growing businesses in Ireland and the UK stay on top of their numbers. You’ll work across a range of clients, solve day-to-day accounting queries and help our team deliver financial information clients can rely on.



What you’ll do

•	Keep client books accurate and up to date, including bank and credit card reconciliations.

•	Maintain customer and supplier ledgers, follow up on outstanding items and resolve differences.

•	Prepare schedules and reconciliations for monthly management accounts and support VAT return preparation.

•	Keep clear records, raise queries promptly and work closely with our accounting team in Ireland.

•	Manage priorities across several clients while meeting agreed deadlines.

What you’ll bring

•	Solid bookkeeping experience and a confident grasp of double entry, reconciliations and ledger management.

•	Experience with Xero or QuickBooks Online or similar cloud-based systems would be a strong advantage.

•	Experience working with multiple clients is highly desirable. 

•	Strong English communication, good organisation and pride in producing accurate work.

Why Solve

You’ll join a growing Manila team with support from colleagues in Ireland, ongoing learning and opportunities to develop as the team expands. We value people, keeping our promises, creating value, quality delivery and integrity. Weekends are yours.

If you enjoy varied bookkeeping work and want to make a real contribution to clients and colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.



Apply now and join our team!

title: Onboarding Accountant
description:
Onboarding Accountant



Remote Manila based  |  10:00am–7:00pm Philippine time  |  Weekends off



Help new clients get off to a great start with Solve Outsource. You’ll take ownership of their accounting transition, get to the bottom of messy records and hand over accurate, reliable accounts to our client service team. Each onboarding brings a new business, a new challenge and a chance to make a visible difference.



What you’ll do



-Review new clients’ accounting records, identify gaps and agree the work needed to get them ready for handover.

-Complete catch-up work and reconcile bank, customer, supplier, VAT, payroll and balance sheet accounts.

-Investigate discrepancies, work with clients and previous providers to obtain information, and help with software migrations.

-Manage several onboarding projects at once, keep clear records and deliver a thorough handover to the ongoing team.

-Work alongside other members of the onboarding team.



What you’ll bring



-An experienced accountant with strong bookkeeping, management accounts and reconciliation skills.

-The confidence to take ownership, solve problems and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.

-Experience with Xero or QuickBooks Online is a strong advantage; experience working with multiple clients is highly desirable.

-Accuracy, organisation and an interest in learning new systems.



Why Solve

We’re a growing outsourced finance team working with businesses across a range of industries. You’ll have variety, supportive colleagues and opportunities to build your technical and client-facing skills. We value people, keeping our promises, creating value, quality delivery and integrity.

If you enjoy untangling accounting challenges and helping businesses start well, we’d love to hear from you.



Apply now and join our dynamic team!

title: Fulltime Junior Creative Strategist
description:
We're looking for a creative strategist who's willing to put in the grind hands-on with the founders.



Here's where we are:



DTC beauty brand, at-home body sculpting device for women with loose skin. Scaling Meta hard in the US.



4 people on the team.



Around 15 creatives launched every week.



Also there's real growth opportunity here and real payouts attached to it when the brand scales, you scale with it.



What you'll be doing



8–10 video concepts and 7–10 image/advertorial concepts per week.



Digging through reviews, Reddit, comment sections, competitor ads that's where angles come from.



Turning those angles into briefs our editors can build: hook, script, storyboard.



Sitting with the founders every week on what launched, what won, what died, and why.



You bring the angles. Our editors build them.



What we're looking for



You don't need years of agency experience. You need to be someone who:



Can't scroll past an ad without breaking down why it worked.



Writes clearly in English and understands the US market (our customers skew 35+).

This is NOT a generic video editing job. I need someone who understands that ads on Meta need to LOOK like real content, not like an ad. If you only know how to edit corporate or YouTube-style videos, this is not for you.

title: Senior Amazon PPC Specialist | Full time | Remote | Long term
description:
You have been running Amazon PPC long enough that we do not need to explain search term reports, bulk files or tools like Perpetua. You use them every week. You have also built AI into your work to clean data, check changes and find patterns faster.



You know when PPC is not the problem. Poor stock, weak reviews, the wrong price or a bad listing can limit what any campaign achieves. Sounds like your kind of job? Read on.



--

About Brightways



Brightways is a marketplace agency based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We manage Amazon and 
 for established and ambitious  brands. We take responsibility for advertising, content, listings and reporting.



On Amazon, we work across all marketplaces. On 
, we mainly manage advertising for Dutch and Belgian brands.



--

What you will do



You are responsible for Amazon and 
 advertising across a set of client accounts. You do this within fixed client teams led by a Marketplace Manager.



Paid advertising and AI



Your main responsibility is improving advertising performance. At the same time, you help us make the work faster, smarter and more consistent with AI.



- Building and restructuring Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns

- Managing advertising campaigns on 

- Researching keywords, products and ASIN targets

- Mining search terms and adding negative keywords

- Managing bids and budgets against ACoS and TACoS targets

- Reviewing weekly and monthly performance

- Using AI to clean data, find patterns and speed up campaign analysis

- Improving existing AI workflows and testing better ways to complete recurring work

- Turning repeatable decisions into clear rules for our internal tools

- Checking AI output before using it to make campaign decisions

- Explaining what changed, why it changed and what should happen next



Your role in the client team



Advertising does not operate on its own. You share what you see with the rest of the team and help connect campaign performance to the wider account.



- Spotting when price, stock, reviews or listing quality are limiting results

- Sharing clear findings and recommendations with the Marketplace Manager

- Working with Operations, Design and Brand to improve the parts affecting advertising performance

- Following through on agreed actions and checking whether they improve sales, margin or efficiency



--

Amazon is only part of the job




 works differently from Amazon. It offers less targeting control, fewer keyword tools and different campaign rules. You will spend real time working on 
, not fifteen minutes on a Friday afternoon.



Experience with 
 is not required. It is rare outside the Netherlands, so we can teach you the platform. You do need to want to learn it properly.



If you only want to work on Amazon, this job will not suit you.



--

What you need



Three things are non negotiable.



1. Real Amazon advertising experience

You have at least three years of hands on Amazon PPC experience. Amazon advertising has been a main part of your work. You know Seller Central and the Amazon Ads console from regular use, not from watching a course.



You currently manage, or have managed, at least $10,000 in monthly advertising spend across accounts.



2. Strong spreadsheet skills

You can build your own analysis in Excel or Google Sheets. You understand pivot tables and lookups. You can clean a messy export and find the number that does not make sense.



3. Daily experience with AI

You already use AI as part of your normal work. We use Claude and build our own AI workflows. You do not need to be an AI expert.



You should understand where AI saves time, where it improves your analysis and where you still need to check the answer yourself. Using AI only to rewrite an
 is not enough.



--

What else we expect



- You work with Helium 10 or a comparable tool

- You can read a search term report and d
 what action to take

- You can explain advertising decisions in clear written English

- You can work independently without waiting for detailed instructions

- You take responsibility for the results of your accounts

- You have reliable internet and a professional setup at home



Comparable tools include Perpetua, Sellerboard and Data Dive.



--

Useful, but not required



- 
 advertising experience

- Experience with European Amazon accounts

- Experience with Kaufland or Zalando

- Knowledge of European reporting requirements

- SQL or automated reporting experience

- Experience documenting processes for colleagues



You do not need to tick every box. The three main requirements above do need to be there.



--

What you get



- Your own accounts from the first month

- Real responsibility for advertising decisions

- Direct contact with the owner

- A long term position

- Tools that reduce repetitive manual work

- Room to improve how we manage and automate advertising



We want people who understand the numbers, make a decision and explain it clearly.



--

How to apply



Skip the generic cover letter. We read your answers before we read your CV. Send us these four things.



1. Your CV

Show us your Amazon advertising experience, the accounts you worked on and the responsibility you had.



2. A short video

Record a video of two to three minutes. A phone camera is fine. Start with: “Hi team Brightways.”



Then tell us:

- Who you are

- Which accounts you manage now

- The total monthly advertising spend you manage

- Which campaign you are most proud of

- What you did and why it worked



We are not judging your camera or editing skills. We want to hear how you think and communicate.



3. Your campaign analysis

Answer this question in about five sentences:



A campaign has been running at 42% ACoS for three weeks. The target is 20%. What are the first three things you check, and in what order?



Do not explain everything you know about ACoS. Show us how you approach the situation.



4. How you use AI to work smarter and more effective

You can also include a screenshot of a real prompt or conversation. That tells us more than a list of AI tools.



--

Applications without the video and answers to questions three and four will not be reviewed.

About the role



Yum Street is a UK event-catering business operating food trucks and Airstreams at festivals, sporting events, corporate functions and private events.



We are looking for a technically capable, self-managed professional to take over our existing WordPress website, custom booking system and CRM integrations, while helping us introduce useful AI tools and AI agents into the business.



We want someone seeking a stable, long-term position who will take ownership of their responsibilities, understand our business and deliver dependable results.



This is a serious full-time commitment. You must start at 08:00am UK time, complete eight working hours each day and remain available to the team during your agreed working schedule. Break arrangements will be agreed separately.



Who we are looking for



You should be someone who:



Manages their own workload without constant chasing or supervision.

Your initial responsibilities

Ongoing responsibilities



Website and booking system

Work with PHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Complete website development tasks and connect forms to the correct booking workflows.

Troubleshoot errors, improve mobile usability and test customer journeys.

Maintain accurate booking records and staff-facing dashboards.



CRM and business automation

Troubleshoot API connections, webhooks and data synchronisation.

Maintain quote reminders, nurture
s, staff notifications and post-event follow-up.

Resolve duplicate records, incorrect statuses and failed automations.

Verify that each workflow produces the intended business result.



AI tools and AI agents

Build and maintain AI agents that can use business information and connect to relevant systems.

Integrate AI with our website, CRM and internal workflows.

Establish clear permissions, human approval steps and escalation routes.

title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

title: TikTok Ads & Ecommerce Marketing Manager
description:
TikTok Ads & Ecommerce Marketing Manager

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Long-Term



Magic Nights Publishing is a U.S.-based children's book company looking for a hands-on TikTok Ads & Ecommerce Marketing Manager to help us grow book sales.



TikTok is our primary digital sales channel, so hands-on TikTok Ads experience is REQUIRED for this position.

We're looking for someone who has actually worked inside TikTok Ads Manager: creating TikTok content, launching campaigns, testing creative, managing audiences, monitoring performance, optimizing campaigns, and using results to improve sales.

We need someone who understands the connection between creative + paid media + ecommerce + conversion and can help us figure out what sells books.



What You'll Own



TikTok Ads & Performance Marketing

• Manage TikTok Ads campaigns from setup through optimization

• Develop and test campaign structures, audiences, creative concepts, hooks, and ad formats

• Monitor performance including CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversions

• Identify winning and losing creative and recommend what to test next

• Work with existing book imagery/video and create or coordinate new ad creative

• Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns and continuously improve results

• Track TikTok-driven traffic and sales

• Manage Meta Ads as a secondary paid channel



Ecommerce & Sales

• Manage Shopify product listings, promotions, links, inventory and sales activity

• Monitor ecommerce performance and identify opportunities to increase conversion

• Track sales by channel and provide simple performance reporting

• Coordinate inventory and fulfillment information with Acutrack

• Prepare ecommerce campaigns for Halloween, book launches and other key sales periods



Content & Organic Social

• Develop TikTok and Instagram content that supports paid and organic growth

• Create short-form videos, graphics, captions and promotional content

• Repurpose existing book content into new creative concepts

• Use paid-ad performance to inform organic content and vice versa



 & Growth Marketing

• Manage Mailchimp campaigns and customer lists

• Develop promotional
s, launch campaigns and seasonal communications

• Identify additional opportunities to grow book sales



The role may also support bookstore/school outreach, events, book awards and other marketing activities, but your primary responsibility is growing ecommerce sales, particularly through TikTok.



Required Experience

You should apply only if you have:

• Hands-on professional experience managing TikTok Ads

• Experience personally setting up and optimizing campaigns in TikTok Ads Manager

• Experience analyzing paid-media performance and making optimization decisions

• Experience with ecommerce or direct-to-consumer products

• Experience with Shopify or another ecommerce platform

• Ability to develop or adapt short-form creative for TikTok

• Working knowledge of Meta Ads

• Strong written English

• Strong organization and follow-through



Experience with children's products, books, consumer products, Mailchimp, Canva, CapCut and Acutrack is helpful but not required.



Who We're Looking For

We don't need someone who has simply boosted TikTok posts or helped create TikTok content.

We want someone who can look at a campaign and say:

What's working? What's not? Why? What should we test next? And how do we turn that into more sales?

You'll have significant ownership over the growth of a small children's book brand with existing inventory, creative assets and products ready to sell.



How to Apply

Please message and include:

1. How many years/months have you personally managed TikTok Ads?

2. Describe one TikTok Ads campaign you personally managed. Include the product, approximate ad spend, your role and results.

3. What metrics do you use to d
 whether to scale, modify or stop a TikTok campaign?

4. Links/screenshots/examples of TikTok ads or campaigns you've worked on, if available.

5. Your experience with Shopify and Meta Ads.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Examples of social media content you've created, edited and managed (TikTok and Instagram)





Important: Please do not apply if your TikTok experience is limited to organic content creation or social media management. Hands-on TikTok Ads Manager experience is required. Content creation is still an important part of the role but that must be paired with ad experience as well.

Turn Instagram opportunities into genuine conversations and qualified sales calls.

My Instagram generates new followers, post engagement, story engagement and inbound conversations.

Qualified sales calls booked.

I

nfluencer Outreach

Personalising outreach

Starting conversations with relevant script 

Tracking influencer leads and collaborations

Escalating interested opportunities

There is an opportunity for the right person to grow into broader lead-generation and sales pipeline responsibilities as the business grows.

Have proven appointment-setting experience

Can demonstrate previous call-booking results

Have excellent, natural written English

Work quickly without sacrificing quality

Can maintain control of multiple conversations

Are organized and comfortable working with a CRM/pipeline

Take feedback onboard and implement it

Communicate proactively

Take ownership when something isn't working

Are reliable and punctual

Are comfortable being measured against clear KPIs

Are motivated by results and performance commission

Want a long-term position where your responsibilities can grow with the business

Please Do NOT Apply If...

You've never personally booked appointments through DMs

Your experience is primarily general admin/data entry rather than sales conversations

You need to learn appointment setting from scratch

You need AI to write normal DM responses for you

You blindly copy and paste scripts

You freeze when somebody says something outside the script

You aren't comfortable being accountable for calls booked, rather than simply activity completed

I'm happy to teach you my business, audience, offer, brand voice and processes.

I'm not looking to teach somebody the fundamentals of appointment setting.

What Success Looks Like

We track activity, but activity alone isn't success.

The pipeline is:

DM → Conversation → Discovery → Qualified Call → Client

You'll have clear KPIs covering areas including:

Daily outreach

Speed to lead

Follow-ups

Qualified conversations

Calls booked

Influencer outreach

CRM/pipeline accuracy

Our current benchmark is a minimum of:

5 qualified sales calls booked per week.

As the business grows, both the targets and earning opportunity can grow.

Compensation & Growth

This is a full-time remote role offering:

Base salary + performance commission

I want somebody who is motivated by results. Strong performance creates the opportunity to earn more.

More importantly, I'm looking for somebody long-term.

For the right person, the role has the potential to grow beyond DM setting into greater responsibility across:

CRM Management → Lead Tracking → Influencer Outreach → Paid Lead Management → Sales Operations

I'm looking for someone who wants to take ownership and grow with the business — not simply complete a task list every day.

What You'll Receive

You'll receive:

DM scripts and conversation sequences

Examples of successful conversations

Brand and offer training

Influencer outreach processes

CRM processes

Regular performance feedback
