Monitoring and managing active Instagram conversations

Responding quickly to inbound messages during your working hours

Welcoming new followers

Messaging story viewers

Messaging people engaging with posts and Reels

Following up with warm leads

Re-engaging ghosted conversations

Starting genuine conversations rather than sending generic outreach

Running effective discovery through DMs

Understanding prospects' goals, struggles, barriers and motivations

Recognising when somebody is appropriately qualified

Naturally transitioning qualified prospects towards a sales call

Booking qualified calls directly onto my calendar

Following up appropriately when somebody isn't ready yet

Maintaining the brand's tone and standard of communication

You'll have a detailed DM Playbook and conversation sequences to work from.

However:

Scripts are a framework - not a substitute for thinking.

If somebody takes the conversation somewhere unexpected, I expect you to read what they actually said, understand it and respond like a human being.

Speed to Lead Is Critical





CRM & Lead Management

As part of the role, you'll increasingly take ownership of our lead pipeline and CRM.

This can include:

Keeping lead records accurate and organised

Updating lead stages and statuses

Tracking booked calls

Recording relevant notes

Monitoring follow-ups

Making sure warm opportunities don't disappear

Maintaining a clean sales pipeline

Identifying leads requiring action

Helping improve tracking and reporting

Previous experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM is highly desirable.

Ultimately, I want somebody who can increasingly own the pipeline rather than wait to be told what needs attention.

I

nfluencer Outreach

You'll also support our influencer lead-generation strategy, currently focused on the US market.

This includes:

Researching relevant influencers

Assessing audience fit and engagement quality

Personalising outreach

Starting conversations with relevant script 

Tracking influencer leads and collaborations

Escalating interested opportunities

Again, I'm interested in quality and commercial awareness, not blindly sending templates.





There is an opportunity for the right person to grow into broader lead-generation and sales pipeline responsibilities as the business grows.

This Role Is For You If...

You:

Have proven appointment-setting experience

Have personally booked sales calls through DMs

Ideally have experience managing Instagram DMs for a coach, online service provider or fitness/wellness business

Can demonstrate previous call-booking results

Have excellent, natural written English

Can communicate without relying on ChatGPT to write every message

Can think independently when conversations move away from the script

Understand discovery and qualification

Know how to ask relevant follow-up questions based on what someone actually tells you

Can recognise buying signals

Know when to keep digging and when to progress towards a call

Work quickly without sacrificing quality

Understand speed to lead

Can maintain control of multiple conversations

Are organized and comfortable working with a CRM/pipeline

Take feedback onboard and implement it

Communicate proactively

Take ownership when something isn't working

Are reliable and punctual

Are comfortable being measured against clear KPIs

Are motivated by results and performance commission

Want a long-term position where your responsibilities can grow with the business

Please Do NOT Apply If...

You've never personally booked appointments through DMs

Your experience is primarily general admin/data entry rather than sales conversations

You need to learn appointment setting from scratch

You need AI to write normal DM responses for you

You blindly copy and paste scripts

You freeze when somebody says something outside the script

You aren't comfortable being accountable for calls booked, rather than simply activity completed

I'm happy to teach you my business, audience, offer, brand voice and processes.

I'm not looking to teach somebody the fundamentals of appointment setting.

What Success Looks Like

We track activity, but activity alone isn't success.

The pipeline is:

DM → Conversation → Discovery → Qualified Call → Client

You'll have clear KPIs covering areas including:

Daily outreach

Speed to lead

Follow-ups

Qualified conversations

Calls booked

Influencer outreach

CRM/pipeline accuracy

Our current benchmark is a minimum of:

5 qualified sales calls booked per week.

As the business grows, both the targets and earning opportunity can grow.

Compensation & Growth

This is a full-time remote role offering:

Base salary + performance commission

I want somebody who is motivated by results. Strong performance creates the opportunity to earn more.

More importantly, I'm looking for somebody long-term.

For the right person, the role has the potential to grow beyond DM setting into greater responsibility across:

CRM Management → Lead Tracking → Influencer Outreach → Paid Lead Management → Sales Operations

I'm looking for someone who wants to take ownership and grow with the business — not simply complete a task list every day.

What You'll Receive

You'll receive:

Detailed DM Playbook

DM scripts and conversation sequences

Examples of successful conversations

Brand and offer training

Influencer outreach processes

CRM processes

Regular performance feedback

Direct access to me when something genuinely needs escalation

There will be plenty of support.

But with that support comes an expectation of ownership, implementation and continuous improvement.

Application Process



The process will include:

Written Application → Practical DM Assessment → Interview → Paid Trial → Offer



ONLY COMPLETED APPLICATION FORMS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

Step 1: Open the folder below.

Step 2: Make a copy of the application document.

Step 3: Complete all questions.

Step 4: Save your completed copy to your own Google Drive.

Step 5: Set access to “Anyone with the link can view.”

Step 6: Submit/share your completed application link according to the instructions in the document.

APPLICATION FORM:



Do not request editing access to the original document.

Applications that don't follow the instructions above will not move forward.



Looking forward to meeting you

We're hiring immediately

title: Business Development Specialist — USA Market
description:
Noble Hearts HR Consulting & Staffing, | Base + Commission



About Us

Noble Hearts HR Consulting & Staffing is a U.S.-based, M/WBE-certified HR consulting and staffing firm. We help businesses across the Southeast with fractional HR support, recruiting, hiring events, and workforce training. We're growing our client base and looking for a driven business development professional to help us bring on new clients.



The Role

This is a base + commission, independent contractor role focused entirely on acquiring new clients. You'll prospect, pitch, and close new business — no cap on what you can earn as your results grow.



You control your schedule. This role requires a minimum of 30 hours per week directed toward prospecting and client development, worked whenever fits your day.



This is a business development role, not a virtual assistant or administrative position. You'll be expected to independently research, prospect, and close deals.



What You'll Do



Identify and prospect new business targets within the SC / GA / FL / NC / NY and Virginia territory

Run outbound outreach — calls,
, LinkedIn — to generate qualified conversations

Present Noble Hearts' HR consulting, recruiting, and staffing services to prospective clients

Close new client agreements and support the transition to onboarding

Track all pipeline activity in the CRM provided



Compensation



Base Rate (Hourly):



Starting rate $3.00/hour

After your first new client closes and their payment is collected $3.50/hour

After 2 consecutive quarters hitting the revenue goal $4.00/hour

After 4 consecutive quarters hitting the revenue goal $5.00/hour



Plus, for every new client you close:



$50 for a new recurring/fractional HR client 

$50 for a new project-based engagement (recruiting search, hiring event, training)

Paid within 15 days of Noble Hearts receiving the client's first payment



Tools Provided



CRM for pipeline and client tracking

UpLead for contact and company-level prospecting data

LinkedIn Sales Navigator for outreach



What You'll Need



Minimum 3 years of business development, outbound sales, or new client acquisition experience specifically targeting the U.S. market 

Ability to independently research, prospect, and engage U.S. businesses with minimal day-to-day direction

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Your own computer, reliable internet, and a phone

Self-discipline to consistently hit the 30-hour/week minimum without close supervision
